tei:div.tei:p: (hūm̐)༄༅// dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gser chos lugs kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi zab khrid myur lam rkang mgyogs sgrub pa'i gom stabs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /rnam gsum tshulaṃ khriṃms rgyan gyis rnam par mdzes pa'i sku// bkra shis dge mtshan dpe byad lhunaṃ gruṃb lham me ba// saṃngs rgyaṃs yon tan rgya mtsho'i dpaṃl 'byor chos mchog rnams// skal bzaṃng 'gro la lam gsungs bla ma rnams la 'dud// shes rab stong pa'i rang rtsal ma 'gags snying rje'i 'gro la rjes 'dzin gzugs// dga' ba bcu drug rgyas pa'i lang tshor dngos grub 'o ma'i bcud 'dzin mtho// bden gnyis phyag gis skyon drug gcod dang bde chen skyong ba'i lag cha bsnams// thabs mchog nam mkha'i dbyug pa 'bral med 'chang gi mkha' spyod dbang mor 'dud// zab yangs tshogs gnyis zung 'jug grub pa'i mthu rtsal rab rdzogs drang srong che// sgrib gnyis lha min spun gyi ngan g.yo bde chen gsus par rmeg med btul// chos gzugs sku la rdzogs pa'i dag byed ji snyed yongs btung nas// ches zab gdams pa'i chu klung 'bum skyug grub dbang nā ro pa// gang gi thugs bcud ches zab gdams pa'i bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig dang*// rdzogs rim dbu ma'i man ngag zung sbyor tshe 'di nyid dam bar do sogs// ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sgyu 'phrul yid 'phrog dga' mas mdun bsu nas// mkha' spyod bde chen grong du 'khrid byed sa skya'i bla chen gser gyi chos// dbang bskur byin rlabs khrid lung 'byung ba'i gnas// lhun grub mtha' can rnam gsum dpal ldan chos// kun dga'i bstan 'dzin sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos// dpal 'byor bzang po'i drin las gang thob pa// chu gter che las zab khrid bdud rtsi'i gter// skal dman lha min myong skabs ma byung ba// myur lam don gnyer skal bzang legs bris bu// bla med byang chub rga shi med pa'i gsos// mi gsal phye dang gab pa mngon phyung ba// dpe mang bsdebs pa'i ngal ba bskyung ba'i slad// grol byed gdams pa'i yid 'phrog bzhin ras brgya// cig char ston pa'i me long 'di na ngom// 'dir rje btsun nā ro pa'i lugs kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i khrid kyi rim pa 'chad pa la/

thog mar slob ma de gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag gi dbu nas 'byung ba'i snang ba gsum gyi khrid sogs thun mong ba'i lam gyi rim pa'i 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang*/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ dkar nag las 'bras kyi khrid rnams dang*/ byang chub tu sems bskyed de/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa rnams sngon du song zin pa zhig yin na/ thun mong ba'i lam de dag ma bshad kyang rung la/ de dag ye ma thob pa zhig yin na/ thun mong ba'i lam de dag gis blo sbyang ba rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa zhig bshad na legs par mngon no// khyad par 'di nyid kyi khrid 'bogs par 'os pa'i slob ma ni/ bde kye sogs kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur gyis smin pa la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i tshul du bskur ba legs par thob cing*/ lam zab mo 'di don du gnyer ba'i slob ma phyag byas nas gral la 'khod pa la/ 'di skad du brjod de/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sogs nas/ zab pa las kyang ches zab pa'i khrid kyi rim pa zab mo gsan la don tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa sogs kyis sems bskyed pa sogs nas snod kyi skyon gsum spangs nas gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par bya ba dang*/ khyad par gnas khang bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rdo rje'i rwa gur phyi rol nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ da ltar gyi slob dpon yang tha mal pa ma yin pa rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku can du gsal ba'i zhal nas chos kyi sgra grag stong skye med kyi rang gdangs lhang lhang yod pa dang*/ khyed rnams kyang rang rang thun mtshams kyi lhag pa'i lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa rnams gsal gdab nas gsan 'tshal/

de la gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gdul bya rnams kyi bsam pa dang mthun par dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi bsam gyis mi khyab par gsungs pa rnams ris su bsdu na theg pa che chung gnyis las/ 'dir theg pa chen po ste/ ji skad du/ nyan thos theg pa 'di la ni// spyod pa yongs bsngo ma bshad pas// theg pa chen po ga la rung*// zhes gsungs so// theg pa chen po la'ang rgyu'i theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu'i theg pa gnyis las/ khyad par du 'phags pa 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa ste/ mdo sde gdams ngag 'bogs pa'i rgyal po las/ 'dren pa'i theg pa gsum po yang*// bcom ldan nges par gsungs lags na// rgyu 'bras lhun grub tu spyod cing*// sangs rgyas gzhan nas mi 'tshol ba'i// nges pa'i theg pa cis ma gsungs// zhes pa'i lan du/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyu la mos pa rgyu chos kyi// 'khor lo rab tu bskor byas nas// rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam zhig /ma 'ongs dus na 'byung bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas shes so// sngags kyi theg pa de la dbye ba mang du yod pa las/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa yab sras rnams kyis/ rdo rje gur gyi rgyud la brten nas rgyud sde bzhir bzhed pa dang*/ rje 'gos kyis ye shes rdo rje kun las btus kyi rgyud la brten nas/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i skabs su rgyud sde lngar bzhed pa yin la/ de bzhin du 'dir yang rtsa rgyud le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa las/ ji srid mdo bya spyod pa ni// rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dbye ba yis// sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa// de dang de la dga' ba yi// zhes gsungs pa la brten nas/ mdo sde rtog pa'i rgyud/ bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ gsang ba'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud de/ rgyud sde sgo drug tu bzhed pa las/ drug pa gsang ba'i mtha' la/

rtsa ba'i rgyud dang bshad pa'i rgyud gnyis las/ dang po la/ rgyud rgyas pa le'u 'bum pa/ de rtsod dus su bshad nyan ma nus pas/ de las bsdus pa sh+lau ka 'bum pa gsungs/ de la rtsod dus su mi 'grub pas/ de las bsdus pa yi ge 'bum pa'i le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa 'di gsung zhes rje btsun gyis/ he ru ka'i byung tshul las bshad cing*/ kun spyod kyi 'grel par/ rgyud rgyas pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa 'bum phrag gsum pa bsdus pa 'di yin par/ gdul bya'i blo'i bye brag gi snang tshul tsam las 'gal ba med par sems so// gang ltar yang bshad bya rtsa ba'i rgyud bsdus pa le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa/ 'di nyid la 'chad tshul rnam pa bzhi yod de/ ma rgyud spyi dang mthun par bshad pa dang*/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang mthun par bshad pa/ dus 'khor dang mthun par bshad pa/ gsang mtha' ltar bshad pa ste/ 'grel byed so so'i bkral tshul bzhi yod pa las/ rtsa rgyud kyi dgongs pa bshad rgyud rnam pa lngas gsang mtha' 'chad de/ bshad rgyud lnga ni/ slob dpon skar rgyal zla bas/ 'byung dang mkha' 'gro kun spyod dang*// kha sbyor rgyud dang bla ma ste// bshad rgyud rnam pa lngar 'dod do// zhes pa lnga ni/ he ru ka mngon 'byung*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod/ dpal sam+bu ṭa/ a bhi dha na rnams kyis bkral ba'i gsang mtha' 'di/ bde mchog gzhan las zab ste/ spyir theg dman nas rdo rje theg pa'i bar dman sems spong zhing rtogs rigs yar ldan du 'gro ba las/ 'og ma 'og ma las gong ma gong ma zab tshul spyi ltar bshad pa yin pa las/ gsang mtha' mchog tu zab ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ pho nya rnam gsum legs bsres nas// sgrub pa po yis dngos grub thob// ces gsungs/ gsang mtha'i lam rim ni/ sbyin bya bzhi/ bslab bya gnyis/ grogs spyod pa gnyis kyi mtshams sbyar nas/ 'bras bu mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub par byed do// dang po ni/

lū nag gnyis kyi phyi'i dkyil 'khor du/ smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba ma thob pa la gang zag mchog ma yin pa rnams kyis dril bu lus dkyil dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lam nyams su blangs na/ rtsa ltung 'byung ba'ang*/ yongs su ma smin sems can la// gsang ba sgrogs pa bdun pa yin// zhes gsungs/ rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rdzogs nyams su len pa la'ang sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i tshul du thob dgos te/ sbyor ba nges par ma byas par// skal min gsang ba ston pa dang*// zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi yan lag gi ltung ba 'byung ba'i phyir ro// gnyis pa skabs su bab pa bshad par bya ba'i chos ni/ rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud thams cad kyi snying po phyung ba'i man ngag rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid kyis dpal ldan nā ro ta pa la dngos su gnang ba'i gdams pa 'di yin la/ nā ro ta pa de nyid kyis slob ma'i mchog 'phags yul na yongs su grags pa'i paṇa chen mang po dag la'ang ma gnang bar bal po pham thing pa sku mched la thugs bcud kyi tshul du gnang ba'i zab chos klog skya shes rab brtsegs dang*/ mal lo tsā ba las rim par brgyud de/ bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sa skya pa chen po la bka' babs pa'i gdams pa khyad par can la/ sa skya pa chen po nyid la'ang spyir rnal 'byor bla na med pa dang 'brel ba'i gdams pa rgya mtsho tsam yod pa las/ mchog tu gyur pa gser chos bcu bzhi'am bcu gsum gyi nang tshan mchog bsgrubs pas thun mong zhar las 'byung ba'i dmar mo skor gsum/ de'i nang nas kyang mchog tu gyur pa nā ro mkha' spyod kyi gdams pa 'di ni bshad par bya ba'i chos so// 'di 'chad pa la don gsum ste/ gang gis nyams su len pa'i gang zag des nyams su blang ba'i lam/ nyams su blang ba'i lam de'i 'bras bu dang gsum/ dang po la/ smin lam 'jug rung gi gang zag dang*/

grol lam bsgom rung gi gang zag gnyis las/ dang po ni/ spyir rdo rje theg pa nas bshad pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad tshang zhing*/ 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag dril gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi thob pa ni rab/ gsum char gyi dbang ma thob na'ang lū nag gang rung gi rdul tshon nam ras bris su thob pa'o// de dag gi dbang ye ma thob kyang ma rgyud dam gnyis med rgyud kyi kye rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa zhig nges par dgos te/ dbang bzhi ma thob pa'i gang zag la byin rlabs dang khrid kyi rim pa bstan du mi rung ste/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ dbang bskur med pa rgyud 'chad dang*// zab mo de nyid sgom byed pa// de don legs par shes na yang*// dmyal bar 'gyur gyi grol ba min// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grol lam bsgom rung gi gang zag ni/ sngar gyi de'i steng du sgrub pa po rang gi sems nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar ye gdod ma nas gnas pa de ngo sprod pa'i ched du sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs legs par thob cing*/ rgyun du chag med du nyams su len pa'i gang zag cig yin la/ de la'ang gzhi'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin nas/ tshes bcu rnam pa gnyis kyi mchod pa la brtson par byas pas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mal bud med kyi gzugs kyis rang gi mdun du byung ba ngo shes nas phyag 'tshal/ gsol ba btab pas/ des sgrub pa po dus de nyid du mkha' spyod du 'khrid par byed pa ni gang zag rab/ de lta bu ma byung na gzhi'i bsnyen pa gnyis la sogs pa dang*/ khyad par sin+dhu ra'i sgrub pa byas te/ dpral bar sin+dhu ras dga' ba 'khyil pa bris la/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i nga rgyal gyis bud med mang po 'du ba'i gnas kun tu nyul pa na/ gang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin pa de'i dpral bar sin+dhu ra'i dga' ba 'khyil pa 'pho 'ong ba yin pas/

nam byung ba na de nyid la g.yon nas bskor zhing gsol ba btab pa na/ de nyid kyis mkha' spyod du 'khrid par byed pa ni 'bring*/ de ltar byas kyang ma byung na/ sgyid lug pa spangs te rgyun du bzlas bsgom la 'bad par byas pas/ nam zhig shi 'phos te bar dor slebs pa'i tshe yang bzlas sgom byed pa'i snang ba 'char la/ des rkyen byas pa bzhin du mkha' spyod nas dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs rnams kyis 'ongs te/ sgrub pa po de seṅge khri'i steng du bzhag steng du gdugs phubs/ 'phan gdugs dang rol mo'i sgra la sogs pas mchod cing*/ me tog gi char 'bebs shing mkha' spyod du 'khrid par byed pa ni tha ma'o// de ltar ma byung na skye ba phyi ma rnams su rnal 'byor ma'i bzlas sgom byed pa'i rigs su skyes nas/ nam zhig na mkha' spyod du bgrod pa ni gang zag shin tu tha shal ba yin no// gnyis pa ni/ de bzhi char gyis thun mong du nyams su blang rgyu'i chos la/ rje sa skya pa chen pos/ nyal dang ldang dang bdud rtsi myong*// tshad med bla ma bdag lhar bskyed// 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*// dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlabs// ngag bzlas yid bzlas gnyis gcig yin// bsam gyis mi khyab rnal 'byor dang*// spyod lam gyi ni rnal 'byor te// de ltar rnal 'byor bcu gcig go /zhes rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi nyams len yod pa las/ dang po la gnyis te/ sgrub pa po spros pa la mi dga' bar stong nyid la mos pa yin na/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor yan chad bsdus pa'i stong nyid de'i ngang la rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod par byas nas nyal/ gnyis pa spros pa la dga' zhing bskyed rim la mos na/ gnas khang chos 'byung du gsal ba'i nang du seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku phyag mtshan spangs pa dang*/ grogs yod na yang de ltar du gsal gdab/

rang nyid kyi sngas mgor seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can du gsal btab nas nyal/ gnyid sad byung na yang de ltar du gsal gdab/ de dag gi sbyang gzhi ni snod kyi 'jig rten 'jig pa dang*/ bcud kyi sems can 'chi ba dang*/ rang gzhan thams cad dge sbyor gyi rtsis ma zin par tha mal du gnyid log pa rnams yin la/ sbyong byed ni de thams cad 'dir nyal ba'i rnal 'byor du bsgyur nas nyams su len pa yin la/ sbyangs 'bras ni sangs rgyas so/ ༈ /gnyis pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor la'ang gnyis te/ gang zag snga ma'i ldang lugs la/ sang tho rangs mkha' spyod kyi dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams kyis ḍā ma ru'i sgra 'khrol zhing byung ba'i rkyen gyis gnyid sad pa na/ chu las nya 'phar ba'i tshul du lag cha spangs pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i skur ldang*/ gnyis pa gang zag phyi ma'i ldang lugs ni/ gnas khang chos 'byung dang*/ rang yang rnal 'byor ma'i skur gsal btab nas ldang ngo*// de dag gi sbyang gzhi ni/ snod kyi 'jig rten chags pa dang*/ bcud kyi sems can skye ba dang*/ rang gzhan thams cad la dge sbyor gyi rtsis ma zin par tha mal gyi snang ba bun long long 'char ba rnams yin la/ sbyong byed ni/ de thams cad 'dir ldang ba'i rnal 'byor du bsgyur nas nyams su len pa yin no/ ༈ /gsum pa bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ sang snga dror bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa'i nang mchod la g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis reg la thigs pa lce thog tu myong bas mgrin pa'i ya ra la wa'i rtsa bzhi'i nang nas mar song ste lus kyi nang thams cad zag med kyi bde bas gang*/ bde chen gyi ye shes rgyud la skyes/ bdud rtsi'i dwangs ma thams cad snying ga'i bam̐ yig la thim pas/ bam̐ yig nyi ma bye ba'i gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur par bsam/ sbyang gzhi ni/

'dod sred kyis kun nas bslangs te zas za ba dang khrus byed pa la sogs pa yin la/ sbyong byed ni/ 'dir bdud rtsi myang ba'i rnal 'byor du bsgyur nas dag pa'i snang bas rgyas 'debs pa yin no// 'di la 'khor lo bde mchog gi zab gnad dga' ba gsum yang tshang ba yin te/ lus rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bsgom pa ni sku'i dga' ba/ mgrin par 'od dpag med kyi gnas yin pas der bdud rtsi myang ba ni gsung gi dga' ba/ bdud rtsi'i dwangs ma thams cad snying ga'i bam̐ yig la thim par bsam pa ni thugs kyi dga' ba'o/ ༈ /bzhi pa tshad med kyi rnal 'byor la dbye ba gsum ste/ lam log pa la khyad par du bya ba skyabs 'gro'i khrid/ lam dman pa las khyad par du bya ba sems bskyed kyi khrid/ 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong ba yi ge brgya pa'i khrid do// dang po gang la skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul/ skyabs su 'gro mkhan gyi gang zag skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul gsum las/ dang po ni/ rang gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs de bai ḍūr+ya'i sa gzhi la gser gyi mig mangs ris su bres pa/ mnan na nem pa/ bteg na spar ba/ reg na phun sum tshogs pa'i bde ba skyed pa/ de'i dbus su rang nyid gnas pa'i mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul/ da ltar gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma 'di nyid rje btsun rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can du bzhugs pa la skyabs gnas kun tshang ba yin te/ bla ma thams cad thugs rgyud gcig pas bla ma kun 'dus kyi ngo bo yang yin/ de nyid kyi phung po lnga dag pa rgyal ba rigs lnga yin pas/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyang yin/ thugs rgyud la bzhugs pa'i spangs rtogs kyi yon tan rnams chos dkon mchog yin pas chos/ phyi nang gi skye mched rnams sems dpa' dang sems ma'i ngo bo yin pas dge 'dun kun 'dus kyang yin/

mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams bka' nyan gsung bstod kyi tshul du bka' 'khor na gnas pas mkha' 'gro chos skyong yang tshang ba yin no// yang na nam mkhar seng khri pad nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i steng na skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam pa rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa de'i spyi bor pad zla'i steng na rnam snang he ru ka sku mdog dkar po g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum phyag g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu bsnol ba 'dzin pa rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa gsal btab/ bla ma zhes pa'i tshe spyi bo'i rnam snang la dmigs pa gtad/ sangs rgyas zhes pa'i tshe bam̐ yig la/ dam pa'i chos zhes pa'i tshe sngags phreng dang gsung la/ dge 'dun zhes pa'i tshe sku la dmigs pa gtad/ skyabs yul 'di gnyis rang gang la mos pa re gtso bor bya yi/ gnyis ka ni ma yin no// gnyis pa skyabs su 'gro mkhan ni/ rang nyid kyi g.yas su pha/ g.yon du ma/ mdun du rang nyid la gnod byed kyi dgra 'dre/ mtha' skor kun tu rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa'i sems can thams cad ston mo chen po la khrom tshogs pa bzhin khrig mer gyis gang bar bsam/ gsum pa skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul ni/ dus 'di nas byang chub bar du/ bla ma la lam gyi 'dren pa/ sangs rgyas la lam gyi ston pa/ chos la lam dngos/ dge 'dun la lam gyi zla grogs zhu snyam pa'i sgo nas/ rang nyid kyis thog drangs pa'i sems can thams cad kyis/ skyabs 'gro byed pa'i sgra dir dir yod par bsams la/ ngag tu skyabs 'gro bzhi skor ram drug skor brgya rtsa dang stong rtsa la sogs pa bya/ de yang kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin par/ snying khong rus pa'i gting nas khyed shes khyed mkhyen skyabs mgon re sa gzhan na med snyam du dkon mchog la blo ling nge bkal ba'i go cha bgos la snying thag pa nas skyabs su 'gro ste/

dper na khang pa'am brag phug la char pa las skyob pa'i nus pa yod kyang*/ yid gnyis the tshom byas nas der ma zhugs na/ kha nas khang pa'am brag phug lan brgyar bzlas kyang char pas gdungs pa la mi phan pa bzhin no// des na skyabs yul dkon mchog rnams kyis rgyu 'bras kyi chos thams cad lag mthil du skyu ru ra bzhag pa bzhin mkhyen pas na mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi spyan yang mnga'/ sems can thams cad la bu gcig pa ltar 'dor ba mi bzod pa lta bu'i thugs rje yod pas na brtse ba yang mnga'/ mkhyen pa dang brtse ba yod kyang nus pa med na ma lag zhwa ma'i bu chus khyer ba bzhin du skyob mi nus pa la nus pa yang tshad med pa mnga' bas/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la yid gnyis dang the tshom spangs te/ sgo gsum 'jug pa rtse gcig tu dril nas skyabs su song na phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab cing*/ sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa la skyob nus pa yin no// skyabs gsol gyi tshig brjod pa ni/ thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ skyabs yul gyi sku las 'od zer 'phros rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la phog pas/ de rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyangs nas rdo rje rnal 'byaur ma'i skur gyur par bsams la mi dmigs par bzhag de nas skyabs yul de 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas dkon mchog gi byin rlabs rang la thim par bsams la/ de'ang sems gsal stong zung 'jug dbyer med pa don dam pa'i dkon mchog gsum du nges pa'i ngang la cung zad mnyam par bzhag go /gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ smon 'jug gi go don gzhan du sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa smon pa/ de'i ched du lam bsgom pa la 'jug pa ste/ 'dir sems bskyed dang tshad med gcig tu song ba'i lugs te/ de'ang rje sa chen gyis/ bdag gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang thob par byas la/

sems can thams cad srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral bar bya'o// zhes pa 'di tsam la tshad med bzhi tshang ste/ sems can thams cad la bu gcig pa ltar brtse ba ni byams pa/ 'di rnams sdug bsngal las bsgral nas rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang la dgod snyam pa snying rje/ de'i ched du bdag rdo rje rnal 'byaur ma'i go 'phang thob pa la dga' snyam pa ni dga' ba/ rnal 'byor ma'i thugs rjes nye ring med par skyong ba btang snyoms tshad med de dag gi don dran bzhin pas/ ngag tu sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho sogs sgrub thabs ltar lan gsum mam khrid kyi dus su ci nus brjod do// gsum pa sdig sgrib sbyong bar byed pa rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas la/ lha bsgom pa/ sngags bzla ba/ bshags sdom bya ba ste gsum las/ 'dir a bhi dha na nas 'byung ba ltar te/ de'ang rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dpal he ru ka zhes sogs kyai rdo rje'i mngon rtogs nas 'byung ba ltar bsgom mo// gnyis pa la gsum/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa/ bzlas rgyu'i sngags/ ji tsam bzlas pa'i grangs so// dang po ni/ rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs kar zla ba la hūm̐ dkar po cig bsam pa la/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ las bdud rtsi bab/ he ru ka'i sku gang*/ de nas dbyibs brgyud/ yum gyi sku gang*/ yab yum gyi sku thams cad las bdud rtsi bab/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs te lus thams cad gang nas/ bshang gci gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis las sdig ltung dri ma thams cad dud khu dang rnag khrag dang kha dog nag po'i gzugs kyis 'thon par bsam/ zhes gsungs pa ltar bya zhing*/ de'ang 'dir a bhi dha na las/

rnal 'byor ma yi dbang yang bskur// zhes yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi bab pa cis kyang dgos so// gnyis pa bzlas bya'i sngags ni/ yi ge brgya pa la mi 'dra ba du ma yod kyang*/ 'dir he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa ste/ de bshad na/ de la oṃ ni bkra shis pa la sogs pa'i don brgyad la 'jug kyang 'dir ni mchog gi dngos grub ster ba'i don to// shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ zhes pa ni/ rdo rje khrag 'thung dam tshig rjes su skyong*// zhes dang*/ ji ltar skyong na/ he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ khrag 'thung nyid kyis nye bar gnas par mdzod// ces so// dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ bdag la brtan par mdzad du gsol// zhes so// su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ bdag la shin tu dges par mdzod// ces so// a nu rak+to me bha wa/ bdag la rjes su chags par mdzod// ces dang*/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ bdag la shin tu rgyas par mdzod/ bskyangs nas ci byed ce na/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha ni/ bdag la dngos grub thams cad stsol// zhes dang*/ sarba karma su tsa me/ las kun la yang bdag gi ni/ zhes dang*/ tsit+taṃ shre yaḥku ru hūm̐ ni/ sems la dge legs su ni mdzod/ ha ha ha ha ho ni/ ye shes lnga'o// bha ga wā na badz+ra he ru ka ni/ bcom ldan rdo rje khrag 'thung du/ ma me muñca he ru ko bha wa/ bdag grol khrag 'thung nyid du mdzod/ ma hā sa ma ya sa twa aḥzhes pa ni/ dam tshig sems dpa' chen po a/ hūm̐ ni thugs kyi sa bon dang*/ phaṭa ni dges pa zhes pa'i don du 'gyur ro// de'ang a bhi dha na las/ dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma// 'di ni kun gyi gsang sngags te// zhes thams cad kyi gsang sngags su bshad do// grangs ni ji tsam mang na bzang yang*/ nyung mtha' la ni nyer gcig tu bshad do// gsum pa bshags sdom ni/ bla chen 'phags pas/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa sogs brjod par gsungs te/ de la'ang stobs bzhi tshang bas bshags na/

sdig pa ji ltar che yang dag par gsungs te/ stobs bzhi ni rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum rten gyi stobs/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa'i las la 'gyod sems drag pos bshags pa rnam pa sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ phyin chad srog la bab kyang sdig pa'i las mi bgyid snyam pa gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs/ thabs 'di dag gis bdag rgyud kyi sdig sgrib thams cad bden par ma grub pa yin pas dag nges snyam pa sor chud pa'i stobs so// de'ang dam tshig thams cad bsdu na/ sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig gsum du 'du bar gsungs shing*/ sdig pa ni nyon mongs pa'i sdig pa/ sgrib pa ni shes bya'i sgrib pa/ nyes pa ni rang bzhin gyi nyes pa/ ltung ba ni bcas pa'i ltung ba/ dri ma ni lus dang gnas kyi dri ma la sogs pa'o// de dag byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol zhes pa'i don to// de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal nas rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sdig sgrib thams cad ngas dag par byas yod ces gsung lhang gis byon zhing rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu nas spyi bo nas rang la thim pas lus 'ja' tshon lta bur gyur par bsams la/ de yang sbyong bya'i sdig pa/ sbyong byed kyi thabs/ sbyong ba po'i gang zag gsum ga rang bzhin gyis ma grub par shes pa'i ngang du cung zad mnyam par bzhag go ༈ /lnga pa maṇ+ḍal bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang sems dang rdor sems bsres pa'i stong nyid de'i ngang las/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can du bskyed/ de'ang sku mdog dmar po bsgom pa ni/ bla ma'i thugs slob ma la rjes su chags pa mtshon/ lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can ni/ dga' ba bcu drug gi yon tan rgyas pa mtshon/ phyag g.yas ḍā ma ru 'khrol ba ni/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi sgras ston pa mtshon/

g.yon thod pa bdud rtsi'i gang ba bsnams pa ni/ chos de nyams su blangs pas rgyud la bde chen gyi ye shes skye ba mtshon no// de la dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo sogs kyis gsol ba lan gsum btab nas rang la bstim pa ni thun mong ba yin la/ thun mong ma yin pa la lnga ste/ bla ma bskyed pa/ zhen pa spang ba/ ku sā li'i tshogs bsags pa/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba/ dbang blangs te de kho na nyid kyi ngang du bzhag pa'o// dang po ni/ sngar gyi gdan de'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i cod pan can/ gzhon nu lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod dang ldan pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa bdag la dges bzhin du bzhugs par bsam/ de'i mdun nas brtsams te g.yon skor du gdan de 'dra ba re re'i steng du/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang nas bzung ste rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma gang yin pa yan gyi brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can gyis bskor te bzhugs par bsam/ de dag gi mtha' skor kun tu'ang bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' chos skyong nor lha'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor te bzhugs par bsam/ de thams cad kyi gnas gsum du yi ge 'bru gsum/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam/ sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad spyan drangs par bsams la/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgya dang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas/ bla ma thams cad la cha tshang ba re thim pas/ thams cad skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur par bsams nas/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// ces sogs dang*/

rdo rje 'chang chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhes sogs kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rnams ngag nas 'don cing*/ mthor btang ngam dma' btang rung khyed shes khyed mkhyen snyam pas gsol ba drag tu gdab/ gnyis pa ni/ de nas rang nyid kyis chags pa skye ba'i yul yid du 'ong ba'i dngos po khang zhing gnyen bshes la sogs pa thams cad bla ma la phul la/ bla mas bdag gir mdzad pas/ chags pa'i rnam rtog thams cad rang grol du song bar bsam/ de bzhin du zhe sdang skye ba'i yul rang nyid la gnod byed kyi mi ma yin pa la sogs pa dang*/ gti mug skye ba'i yul bar ma'i 'gro ba la sogs pa thams cad phul la/ de thams cad bla mas bdag gir mdzad pas zhe sdang dang gti mug gi rnam rtog thams cad rang grol du song bar bsam/ gsum pa ni/ de nas rang gi snying gar sems nyid kyi ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam gnas pa de nyid spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga rgya mthongs kha phye ba lta bu'i nang nas yar song ste/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dang zhal sbyor du bzhugs pa la/ slar phyi mig bltas pas/ rang gi phung po de nyid che ba snum pa/ tsho bar 'dug pa la sngar lus ji snyed cig blangs kyang don med du song*/ da lan don can bya'o snyam nas phung po'i rtsar byon nas gri gug gis smin mtshams/ rna ltag g.yas g.yon gnyis/ ltag pa rnams su reg pa tsam byas pas/ thod pa de nyid bog yong la khad yod pa la/ lag pas blangs te/ stong gsum gyi khyon dang mnyam par gyur pa de nyid mi mgo'i sgyid pu gsum gyi steng du bkal la/ lag na yod pa'i gri gug gis rkang pa g.yon pa dum bu gsum du gtubs nas thod pa'i nang du bskyur/ de bzhin du rkang pa g.yas dang*/ lag pa gnyis kyang dum bu gsum gsum du gtubs la thod pa'i nang du bskyur/ nang khrol don snying rnams kyang dum bur gtubs nas thod pa'i nang du bskyur/ de bzhin du lus kyi khog pa dang mgo bo'i lhag ma yang thod pa'i nang du bskyur bas/

sha'i ri bo/ khrag gi rgya mtsho/ rus pa'i gram brul dang bcas pa'i thod pa stong gsum gyi rgya khyon dang mnyam pa la/ 'og nas me rang 'bar du byung bas/ de rnams khol zhing zhu bas zag med kyi bdud rtsi kha dog dkar ba/ dri zhim pa/ ro mngar ba/ reg bya bsil ba/ nus pa shi nas zhag bdun song ba yang gso bar nus pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis thod pas bdud rtsi nas bcus te/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes lan gsum gyi bar du phul ba bzhes nas/ shin tu mnyes shing*/ thugs rgyud zag med kyi bde bas gang*/ bdag la shin tu mnyes pas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad da lta nyid du stsol ba'i bdag nyid can du bsam/ slar yang rang gi snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo lag na thod pa thogs pa du ma spros nas/ de rnams kyi thod pas bdud rtsi nas bcus te/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing gsol bas thugs rgyud zag med kyi bde bas gang*/ bdag la shin tu mnyes te/ bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes da lta nyid du stsol ba'i bdag nyid can du bsam/ lha mo rnams slar tshur 'dus nas rang nyid la thim/ de bzhin du snying ga nas lha mo du ma spros nas/ de rnams kyi thod pas bdud rtsi bcus te/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma gzhan rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams sprin phung gtibs pa bzhin bzhugs pa rnams kyi zhal du gsol bas/ de thams cad thugs rgyud zag med kyi bde bas gang*/ dngos grub thams cad stsol bar bsam/ slar yang sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis thod pas bdud rtsi bcus te/ yul bdag gnas bdag gzhi bdag rnams kyi zhal du gsol bas/ de rnams zag med kyi bde bas rgyud gang zhing*/

rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur nas/ bdag gi chos sgrub pa'i stong grogs byed par bsam/ slar lha mo rnams tshur bsdu/ slar yang bdud rtsi'i lhag ma rnams/ rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa'i sems can thams cad la byin pas/ thams cad zag med kyi bde bas rgyud gang bas sems rtog med chos kyi sku dang*/ lus zag med bde chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur nas/ rang rang so so'i gnas dag pa'i zhing du sems can gyi don gyi phyir song bar bsam/ bzhi pa ni/ 'bru gtsang ma dang maṇ+ḍal sogs 'dus byas te/ bla ma la maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma dang*/ so bdun ma rnams mang nyung ji ltar rigs pa 'bul/ shes na gang gi mchod rdzas sogs kyang brjod/ lnga pa ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag la dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ yig dkar po las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ bdag gi dpral ba nas thim pas/ lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ bla ma'i sku'i byin rlabs lus la zhugs par bsam/ dbang gong ma gsum len tshul yang des rigs 'gre/ de dag gi sbyang gzhi ni/ skye ba'i srid pa 'di dang*/ skye ba snga ma rnams su yul dag pa lha dang bla ma nas/ yul ma dag pa ljang ba'i srin bu'i bar yan chad la brten nas las ngan ji snyed bsags pa thams cad sbyong bar byed cing*/ gzhung gzhan dang bstun na bsod nams tshogs bsags kyang yin no// de rnams ni bla ma bskyed pa'i zhal shes yin la/ bstim pa'i zhal shes ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlabatu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ mtha' skor gyi lha tshogs gzhan thams cad 'od du zhu nas brgyud pa'i bla ma la thim/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang 'od du zhus nas/

rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la thim pa nas/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i gong ma'i bar bstim/ de ltar mi nus na brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad 'od du zhu nas rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ rtsa ba'i bla ma yang yar gdan seng khri nas/ mar spyi bo nas 'od du zhu nas thugs ka'i thad du 'od zer dmar po bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur pa de bdag gi spyi bo nas mar thim/ snying gar bde khril gyis byung nas bam̐ yig la thim/ bam̐ yig je cher song nas sngags phreng rnams kyang bam̐ yig tu song de nas zla ba chos 'byung dang*/ lus thams cad dang*/ gnas khang la sogs pa dang*/ mthar stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gyi khams dang*/ nam mkha'i khams thams cad kyang bam̐ yig tu song ba la sems gtad cing mthar/ bam̐ yig kyang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar song nas mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi ngang la lhod de 'jog de nyid tshigs bcad du bsdebs te 'don par spro na/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rin chen seṅge'i khri// sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba'i gdan steng du// skyabs gnas kun 'dus drin chen chos kyi rje// rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje chos// sku mdog dmar po rdo rje dril bu bsnol// bgrang bya bcu drug son pa'i lang tsho can// sna tshogs dar dang rin chen rus pas brgyan// zhabs gnyis mi phyed rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// de mthar brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad ni// dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pas bskor// gzhan yang yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems// nyan thos rang rgyal chos skyong srung ma dang*// nor lha'i tshogs kyis bskor te bzhugs par gyur// kun gyi gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan// hūm̐ las 'od 'phros bla ma yi dam sogs// skyabs yul ma lus spyan drangs dbyer med thim// zhes pas gsal btab nas/ gang gi drin gyis lhan skyes bde ba che// skad cig nyid la 'char ba'i yon tan gter// 'dren mchog bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad+mar spyi bos 'dud// ces dang*/

brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs gang rung 'don/ de ltar mi nus pa'am bsdu na/ smin byed dbang dang byin rlabs rjes su gnang*// ches zab khrid dang rgyab rten lung gi chos// dngos dang brgyud pas legs 'doms bla ma'i tshogs// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol ba btab/ yid kyis sprul pa'i nyer spyod rnams/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā'i bar re re'i 'gor sbyar gyis mchod la/ gang la chags na nyes kun 'byung ba'i gzhi// longs spyod gnyen dang mdza' bshes ji snyed pa// rje btsun bla ma mchog la dbul bar bgyi// 'dod chags rnam rtog zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// mthong thos reg pas zhe sdang 'phel ba'i gzhi// gnod byed dgra 'drer snang ba ji snyed pa// de kun bla ma mchog la dbul bar bgyi// zhe sdang dbyings su zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// tshe rabs du mar grangs med mar byas kyang*// las nyon dbang gis gnyen 'brel ma shes pa// bar ma'i 'gro rnams khyed la dbul bar bgyi// gti mug phrag dog zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes zhen pa spang ngo*// rang sems ngo bo snying ga'i rnal 'byor ma// dbu ma'i lam brgyud tshangs pa'i sgo nas thon// rtsa ba'i bla mar zhal sbyor bzhugs pa yis// phan tshun bde ba chen pos mnyes par gyur// slar yang rang sems mkha' spyod dbang mo yis// rang gi tha mal phung po la gzigs pas// che zhing snum la tsho bar 'dug pa mthong*// sngar yang 'di 'dra'i lus kun don med song*// da lan don can bya 'o dgongs nas ni// phung po'i rtsar byon gri gug rnon po yis// tha mal lus su snang ba'i mgo bo yi// ya thod bcad de thod pa'i sgyed bur bzhag /gang de ches dkar yangs pa'i snod gyur pa// rkang g.yon g.yas dang khog smad nang khrol dang*// khog stod lag gnyis mgo bo'i lhag mar bcas// de nang bskyur bas sha khrag rus pa'i gter// 'og nas me 'bar thod pa'i nang rdzas rnams// bskol zhing zhu ba kha dog dri ro bcud// phun tshogs bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor oṃ āḥhūm̐// snying ga'i bam̐ las yid 'phrog lha mo'i gzugs// grangs med spros pas thod pa'i bdud rtsi las// bcus nas blangs te 'bul ba'i mchod pa 'di// bdag la brtse ba'i thugs kyis nyer dgongs nas// dgyes pa chen pos bzhes par mdzad du gsol// drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin can// 'khor lo'i mgon po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// skyabs gnas kun 'dus zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// brgyud pa'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// yi dam lha tshogs zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// sangs rgyas byang sems zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// nyan thos rang rgyal zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// chos srung nor lha'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// dgyes par rol nas thugs rgyud zag med kyi// bde ba chen pos yongs su mnyes gyur nas// bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad la// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// gzhi bdag gnas bdag rigs drug sems can rnams// yi dam lhar gsal zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// chags sdang gti mug rnam rtog zhi ba dang*// byang chub sems 'byongs sangs rgyas thob gyur cig

/de nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/ bdag gzhan lus dang longs spyod dge bar bcas// khor yug lcags ris yongs bskor dbyig 'dzin mar// lha gnas grangs med bkod legs lhun po dang*// gser gyi ri bdun rol ba'i chu gter dang*// dge bcu tshang ba'i gling dang gling phran brgyad// dpag bsam 'dod 'jo'i ba mo ma rmos 'bras// nyi zla lha mi'i dpal 'byor maṇ+ḍa la// 'khor lo'i mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i dpa' bo yis// bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug mda' gzhu legs sbyar nas// sgrib gnyis dgra bo lhag ma med bcom nas// zung 'jug sku bzhi'i rgyal srid thob par mdzod// ces dang*/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun pa dang*/ sa gzhi spos byug dang*/ so bdun can sogs ci nus phul mthar/ mtha' skor bzhugs pa'i mchod yul thams cad ni// dbyings kyi rol pas rtsa ba'i bla mar thim// sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// bdag la dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol// bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od dkar po// oṃ gyi gzugs byung rang gi dpral bar thim// bum pa'i dbang thob lus kyi dri ma dag /sku yis byin brlabs sprul sku'i sa bon gzhag /bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od dmar po// āḥyi gzugs byung rang gi mgrin par thim// gsang ba'i dbang thob ngag gi dri ma dag /gsung gis byin brlabs longs sku'i sa bon gzhag /bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od sngon po// hūm̐ gi gzugs byung rang gi snying gar thim// gsum pa'i dbang thob yid kyi dri ma dag /thugs kyis byin brlabs chos sku'i sa bon gzhag /bla ma'i yi ge gsum las 'od sna tshogs// 'bru gsum gzugs byung rang gi gnas gsum thim// bzhi pa'i dbang thob sgrib pa bag chags dag /kun gyis byin brlabs ngo bo nyid skur gyur// zhes pas dbang bzhi blangs// slar yang 'khor lo'i mgon po mnyes bzhin du// bde ba chen por 'od zhu rang la thim// snying ga'i bam̐ dang dbyer med 'dres pa'i ngang*// bla ma sku bzhi lhun grub rang zhal skyong*// zhes bla ma rang la bstim nas de kho na nyid kyi ngang du ci gnas su mnyam par gzhag go

/stong nyid du bsgoms pa 'dis 'chi ba'i srid pa sbyang zhing*/ gzhung gzhan dang bstun na ye shes tshogs bsags 'dis mtshon pa yin no// de ltar bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom dgos pa'ang*/ sangs rgyas thob pa la sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rtogs dgos la/ de rtogs pa yang bla ma dam pa'i man ngag dang thabs bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po rdzogs pa la brten dgos te/ brtag gnyis las/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus thabs brten pa dang*// bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes dang*/ sdud pa las kyang*/ ji srid dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su ma rdzogs par// de srid stong nyid dam pa de ni rtogs mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs pa'ang bla ma'i rnal 'byor las lhag pa med de/ mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yi// sku ni bskal par bsgoms pa bas// bla ma dran pa bsod nams che// zhes dang*/ gsang 'dus las/ sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed la mchod pa byas pa bas/ bla ma'i ba spu'i bu ga gcig la til mar gyis byugs pa phan yon che'o// zhes pa la sogs pa mdo rgyud thams cad nas mthun par gsungs so// 'o na bla ma dang sangs rgyas gnyis kyi nang nas bla ma yul lhag pa yin nam snyam na/ de gnyis spangs rtogs la khyad par med mod/ rang nyid la sangs rgyas kyi sku dngos su snang ba dang*/ gsung dngos su thos pa'i skal ba ma byung ba la/ rang dang skal ba mnyam pa bla ma'i skur bzhengs nas/ chos dngos su ston pa mdzad pas na/ sku drin gyi ngos nas bla ma lhag pa yin gsungs so// drug pa bdag lhar bskyed pa la gnyis te/ sbyang gzhi ngos bzung ba/ sbyong byed kyi lha bskyed pa'o// dang po ni/ sbyang rgyu'i gzhi rang gi sems nyid gnyis su med pa'i ye shes chos sku skye med zung 'jug brjod bral de kho na nyid chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs su gyur pa'i spros bral stong pa nyid zla ba'i steng na phung khams skyed mched la sogs pa 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad sems la bag chags kyis tshang*/

lus la rtsa yi ge'i tshul du dod/ de'i stobs kyis phyi rol du gnas snod kyi 'jig rten/ bcud kyi sems can bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'char ba yin te/ de'ang 'od gsal de bag chags kyis bslad pa la brten nas/ ma rig pa langs/ nyon mongs pa gti mug de las 'dod chags/ de las zhe sdang*/ de las nga rgyal dang ser sna langs te bar do'i snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'char la/ de nas gang du skye ba len pa'i gnas gzhi/ skye ba len pa'i gnas kyi 'jig rten/ skye ba blangs pa'i bcud kyi sems can la'ang dmyal ba la sogs pa'i 'gro ba rigs drug rigs drug po de'i lus sems la bde sdug 'dod mi 'dod bsam gyis mi khyab pa cig shar/ nang gi rten dkyil 'khor bzhi'i stobs kyi shar ba yin te/ phyi rol du gzugs sdug mi sdug ji snyed yod pa rnams nang rtsa'i stobs kyis shar cing*/ phyi ru sgra snyan mi snyan gyi bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams nang gi yi ge'i stobs kyis shar la/ phyi rol du tshor ba bde sdug btang snyoms la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams nang gi bdud rtsi'i stobs kyis shar ba yin la/ phyi rol du rnam rtog bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams nang rlung gi stobs kyis shar ba yin te/ ye shes thig le las/ stong pa las ni thams cad 'byung*// zhes dang*/ sdom 'byung las/ rnam pa sna tshogs dri med yid// dkyil 'khor dag ni 'phro bar snang*// zhes gsungs/ des na phyi rol du shar tshad nang na gnas/ nang na gnas tshad phyi rol du shar ba yin te/ ye shes thig le las/ phyi dang phyi yi don rnams kyis// nang gi don gnas shes par bya'o// zhes dang*/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ 'jig rten phyi rol de bzhin nang*// zhes pa dang*/ kye rdor rtsa rgyud las/ ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin nang*// zhes gsungs so// des na phyi rol du snang tshad nang gi rten dkyil 'khor bzhi la tshang ba yin no// de'ang dang por rtsa dbu ma/

de las ro rkyang gnyis/ de las sbas pa'i rtsa lnga/ de las nyi shu rtsa lnga/ de las sum cu rtsa bdun/ de las bsam gyis mi khyab pa gyes pa rnams dang*/ bdud rtsi yang dang por dwangs ma/ de las khu khrag gnyis/ de las khams bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams/ rlung yang dang por gnas pa/ de las ldang 'jug gnyis/ de las rtsa ba'i rlung lnga/ de las rlung bcu/ de las nyi khri chig stong bsam gyis mi khyab pas so// rten dkyil 'khor bzhi po de'i stobs kyis phyi rol snod bcud kyi snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa thams cad sems nyid kyi rnam 'phrul yin pas de dag blo yi yul du nges par bya ba ni rgya che ba'i sbyang gzhi yin la/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ni zab pa'i sbyang gzhi/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa ni mthar thug gi sbyang gzhi yin no// gnyis pa sbyong byed kyi lha la gnyis/ lha spyir bstan pa/ bye brag tu lha bskyed pa dngos so// sbyong byed kyi lha rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la dbye na/ rang sems spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba ni gsang ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ lte ba'i rtsa mdud gru gsum gyi nang na ma las thob pa'i khams gnyis dwangs sum dwangs kyis khrig mer gyis gang ba a thung shad kyi rnam pa can nam chos 'di pa'i thun mong ma yin pa la/ bam̐ yig gi rnam pa can ni nang gi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ phyi rol 'og min na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma ni lhan skyes kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ yul nyer bzhi dang gnas sum cu rtsa bdun na bzhugs pa'i sprul pa'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams ni zhing las skyes pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ ma mkha' 'gro ma yin pa'i rigs su skyes pa rnams ni rigs las skyes pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ yul dang yul gru thams cad na gnas pa'i bud med rnams ni las las skyes pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bsgoms pa ni sngags las skyes pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'o// de ltar na rang gi sems nyid ye gdod ma nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin pa de/

bla mas byin rlabs kyi dus su yin par ngo sprad/ rang nyid kyis kyang yin par ngo shes nas de'i rgyun skyong ba la bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len byas pas/ phyi rol gyi dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams dbang du 'dus/ de rnams dbang du 'dus pas/ 'og min gyi rdo rje rnal 'byor mas byin gyis rlob/ des byin gyis rlabs pas rang sems la lhan skyes kyi rtogs pa 'char la/ de ni byin rlabs yas rlob dang rtogs pa mas 'char zhes pa'i don to// gnyis pa bye brag tu lha bskyed pa la'ang gnyis te/ bdag gi gzhi sbyang bsgyur dang*/ go cha bgo ba'o// dang po ni/ rang gi snying gar e byi ru'i mdog can gnyis brtsegs las/ chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs chos 'byung phyi ma de dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin rnyog pa med pa'i rtse mo mdun la bstan pa/ zur gnyis ldeb la bstan pa/ rtsa ba phra ba gsang gnas su zug pa/ gdengs ka che ba gyen du bstan pa/ chos 'byung nang ma zur gcig sgal tshigs phyogs su bstan pa dang*/ zur gnyis nu ma g.yas g.yon gyi thad du bstan pa de'i kha mtshams 'phel kha che ba'i thad du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar bsil nya gang ba/ de'i dbus su bam̐ yig gi mthar g.yon skor du sngags phreng kha dog dmar po gyen du langs pa/ de yang bam̐ yig gi mdun du oṃ gsum de'i 'khris su sarba log pas rbas/ de'i 'khris su bud+dha log bas d+dhabu/ de'i 'khris su ki ḍā/ de'i 'khris su ye nī/ de'i 'khris su dz+rab/ de'i 'khris su r+ṇawa/ de'i 'khris su ye nī/ de'i 'khris su dz+rab/ de'i 'khris su ro bai/ de'i 'khris su ye nī tsa/ de'i 'khris su hūm̐ gsum dang*/ phaṭa gsum rnams/ de'i 'khris su hā swā/ hā swā oṃ dang po rtsa bar slebs pa legs par bsam/ 'di'i sbyang gzhi ni bar do'i srid pa sbyong bar byed pa yin no// sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros/ sdig pa sgrib pa rnam smin gdos bcas sha khrag gi phung po dang bcas pa 'od gsal stong pa nyid du sbyangs/

lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs yangs pa'i nang du/ zhes brjod na snod kyi 'jig rten sbyong byed du 'gyur bas legs gsungs/ sgrub pa po 'khor bar gnas kyang 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pa'i brdar sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ byang chub kyi sems kyi myu gu 'phel zhing smin pa'i rtags su nyi ma dang 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i gdan gyi steng du/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog pad+ma ra ga'i mdog ltar dmar ba ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas 'od zer dmar po 'phro bas/ bskal pa'i me dpung lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ chos thams cad de bzhin nyid du ro gcig pa'i brdar zhal gcig bden pa gnyis zung du chud pa'i brdar phyag gnyis/ nga rgyal la sogs pa'i skyon thams cad gcod pa'i brdar g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyangs pa'i so rnon 'khor ba'i phyogs la 'phyar thabs su bsnams pa/ mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub brnyes pa'i brdar g.yon pas zla ba ltar dkar ba'i thod pa'i nang bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyi khrag gis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung ba/ bde chen gyi ye shes brnyes pa'i rtags su thod pa g.yas su cung zad yo nas khrag gi rgyun 'bab pa zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ rang nyid shes rab ma yin pa'i brdar zhal g.yon du phyogs pa/ thabs he ru ka dang ya ma bral ba'i brdar phrag pa g.yon par kha ṭ+wāṃ ga yu ba dkar po brgyad gzhogs byas pa lus tshad dang mnyam pa rtsa ba la rdo rje phyed pas mtshan pa rtse mor sna tshogs rdo rje dang de'i steng du bum pa/ de'i khar thod pa skam rlon 'dres ma gsum brtsegs pa'i khar rdo rje rtse lnga pa sgong pos mtshan pa/ sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i brdar ḍā ma ru dang*/ dril bu dang*/ 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang ba/ rtsa ba mdun dang*/ rtse mo rgyab la brten nas phrag par bsnams pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/

ye shes lnga'i yon tan rdzogs pa'i rtags su thod skam lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ de yang leb mo sor mo bcu gnyis pa'am sor bzhi pa kha mig gi rnam pa yod pa/ nang gi ā li kā li lnga bcu dag pa'i brdar thod skam lnga bcu ro skra la brgyus pa brla nas phrag pa'i bar do shal du 'phyang ba/ dga' ba bcu drug rgyas pa'i brdar gzhon nu lo bcu drug gi na tshod can/ kun 'dzin gyi rtog pa thams cad kyi mdud pa grol ba'i brdar dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag pa sil bur gyur pas sku rked yan chad khebs pa/ snying rje chen pos sems can thams cad rjes su 'dzin pa'i brdar zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i nu ma'i steng nas mnan pa/ de yang nu ma 'dod chags skye ba'i gnas yin pas de mnan pa yin no// shes rab chen pos 'khor ba'i phyogs su ma lhung ba'i brdar zhabs g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mgo bo rgyab tu bltabs nas snying ga'i thad du dpral ba nas jir gyis mnan pa/ de yang snying ga zhe sdang skye ba'i gnas dang dpral bar phrag dog skye ba'i gnas yin pas de gnyis mnan pa'o// spyi bor rus pa'i 'khor lo drwa mig sum cu so gnyis pa/ skra thams cad drwa mig gi nang nas yar drangs pa rna ba gnyis la rus pa'i a long gnyis brtsegs rus thung dang bcas pa/ mgrin par rus pa'i gzhung gsum drwa mig bcu drug pa/ lte bar rus pa'i gzhung gsum drwa mig drug cu rtsa bzhi/ smad rgyan nam 'og pag byin pa tsam du sleb pa/ de'i spyi gtsug tu rang chas kyi rigs bdag rnam snang he ru ka dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa/ sku ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa legs par gsal gdab/

'dis ni skye ba'i srid pa sbyong bar byed do// yang 'di la 'khor lo sdom pa'i zab gnad bdag gzhan gyi gzhi sbyang bsgyur zhes bya ba'i bdag gi gzhi sbyang bsgyur gnyis tshang ba yin te/ sngags phreng las 'od 'phros nas sdig sgrib rnam smin phung po dang bcas pa stong pa nyid du sbyang ba ni bdag gi gzhi sbyang ba dang*/ de'i ngang las rang nyid rje btsun ma'i sku zhal phyag rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa dang ldan par bskyed pa ni bdag gi gzhi bsgyur ba yin no// gnyis pa go cha bgo ba ni/ lha nyid sngags kyi gzugs kyis ni// sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster// zhes gsungs pa'i ngo bo lha yin pa la rnam pa yig 'bru'i gzugs su bsgoms te/ rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lte ba'i nang thad du oṃ bam̐/ snying gar bam̐ yig gi mdun du ham̐ moṃ/ lce'i gzhung du hriṃ moṃ/ dpral ba'i skra mtshams su hriṃ hriṃ/ spyi gtsug rus pa dang klad pa'i hrag tu hūm̐ hūm̐/ yan lag ste bru mo dang spyi zur spangs pa'i tshigs chen brgyad ni rkang pa'i tshigs bzhi lag pa'i tshigs bzhi ste tshigs chen brgyad du phaṭa phaṭa rnams kha dog sgrub thabs ltar bsgom mo/ ༈ /bdun pa 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas phar song*/ sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib rnam smin gyi phung po dang bcas pa skad cig nyid la sbyangs/ thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku rgyan cha lugs zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs par gyur par bsam/ 'di la gzhan gyi gzhi sbyang bsgyur gnyis tshang ba yin no// de'ang phyi nang snod bcud thams cad rang sems kho na yin pa'i don gyi sbyang ba dang bsgyur du btub pa yin gyi/ rang las tha dad du grub pa zhig yin na/ de dag sbyang bsgyur du mi rung gsungs/ 'gro ba rdo rje rnal 'byor mar byas pa 'di rnams skabs 'di nyid du rang la bsdu ba'am/

'og ye shes pa bstim pa dang mnyam du bsdu ba gang mos bya'o// 'dir lus dkyil gyi lha gsal gdab pa ni/ snying ga'i chos 'byung gi steng nang gi zla ba'i dbus su bam̐ yig gi ngo bo rnal 'byor ma dmar mo/ bam̐ yig gi srog ya ra la wa bzhi las/ shar

'di la rmor chen pa'i zin bris su byang du ya'i ngo bo nub tu ra'i ngo bo sogs gsungs pa'ang shin tu 'thad pa snang bas gang mos bya/ du ya'i ngo bo rnal 'byor ma dkar mo/ g.yon du ra'i ngo bo ljang gu/ rgyab tu la'i ngo bo dmar mo/ g.yas su wa'i ngo bo rnal 'byor ma ser mo/ mtha'i sngags phreng gi yig 'bru so gnyis kyang re re nas rnal 'byor ma dmar mo re re ste/ kun dril bas lus dkyil gyi lha so bdun legs par gsal gdab/ 'di legs par bsgoms na nang gi gnas so bdun gyi rlung sems thams cad dbu mar thim nas sa lam bgrod cing*/ phyi rol gyi yul so bdun na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams dbang du 'du ba yin zhes gsungs so/ ༈ /brgyad pa dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlab pa ni ngag tu phaiṃ zhes brjod cing*/ sems kyi dmigs pa ni rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu'i rnam pa can 'phros/ dbu ma'i nang nas yar song nas smin mtshams kyi thad nas 'thon par bsam/ de'i tshe lus kyi phyag rgya ni/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i bshad rgyud las/ mdzub mo mdud byas zhes sogs gsungs te/ mthe bong gnyis lto sbyar mdzub mo gnyis mdud gung mo gnyis rtse sbyar zhing gzhan rnams 'bar ba ltar byas pa 'bar ba'i phyag rgya'o// sam+bu ṭa las/ ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i phyag rgya zhes gsungs la/ rkang pa'i stabs sogs rgyun du ma grub kyang*/ sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gsum shin tu gal che bas/ sngags ni phaiṃ mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig ces pa brjod de/ phaiṃ zhes pa thung ngu ma yin pa/ phe dang e dang ma ste yi ge gsum gyi gdangs thon tsam bya ste/ pho nya gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i don yin la/ bod skad du/ khos zhes bya ba'i don yin te/ sngags dang phyag rgya 'dis spyan drangs pas/ gal te mi 'byon na/ dam tshig nyams pas mgo bo khos zhes bya ba'i don yin gsungs pas/

phaiṃ gyi sgra dang bcas shing mig gyen du bgrad/ rkang pa'i mthe bong g.yas pas g.yon pa mnan/ lus kyi 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas smin mtshams kyi thad du lan gsum g.yon du bskor par bya'o// gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin ni/ de'i tshe smin mtshams nas spros pa'i 'od zer des 'og min na bzhugs pa'i lhan skyes kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ yul nyer bzhi na bzhugs pa'i zhing skyes dang*/ 'gro ba thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur pa sngags las skyes pa rnams steng nas char 'bab pa dang*/ 'og nas sa rlangs rdol ba dang*/ bar nas dge 'dun chos 'khor la 'tshogs pa lta bur byung nas rang nyid rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i spyi bo la sogs pa nas sib sib thim par mos la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod/ bdag nyid thabs shes gnyis su med pa la gnas pa bzhin du 'gro ba thams cad kyang thabs shes gnyis su med pa la gnas par bsams la/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sogs brjod/ sngags don ni rnal 'byor dag pa chos thams cad rnal 'byor dag pa nga'o// zhes pa'i don du 'gyur te/ rnam lnga 'dod pa'i bskor ba dang bcas pa'i mthar 'khyud rgya bya ba ni nga rgyal 'dzin pa'o// de ltar na sngar bshad pa de dag gi gtso bor bsgom bya'i don la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs bcad nas/ dpyad don nyams su blang ba sems 'dzin gyi khrid la/ nga rgyal la sems 'dzin pa dang*/ rnam pa la sems 'dzin pa'o// dang po ni/ snying gar e las chos 'byung gnyis brtsegs bskyed pa nas bzung shud+dho3haṃ gi bar/ rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod par shar sgom gyi tshul du nyams su blangs nas de'i rjes su nga ni spangs rtogs kun rdzogs pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dngos yin no snyam du nga rgyal la sems 'dzin/ gnyis pa rnam pa spyi la sems 'dzin pa dang*/ rnam pa bye brag la sems 'dzin pa'o// dang po ni/ yin tshul rgyan cha lugs zhal phyag gi rnam pa can 'di lta bu yin no snyam du rnam pa spyi la sems 'dzin/

gnyis pa la rnam pa bye brag pa la'ang gnyis te/ rgyan med la sems 'dzin pa dang*/ rgyan can la sems 'dzin pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rang gi smin mtshams su spyan dbus ma dbus nag pa mtha' skya ba spyan rtsa dmar shig ge ba spyan g.yon pa gyen la bslang pa lta bu g.yas phyogs su rdzi ma dang bcas pa la sems 'dzin/ de yang gsal po byung ba'i tshe de la zhen nas bsdad na myur du rnam rtog gi rkun pos 'phrog 'gro/ gsal po ma byung ba'i tshe gsal po yong la re bas bsdad na sems dang dmigs pa 'gres nas phyis bsgom skye ba'i gegs byed pas gsal na gsal te 'phro bcad/ mi gsal na mi gsal te 'phro bcad/ yang yang bsgoms kyang gsal po ma byung na/ spyan dbus ma shog bu la bris pa mdun du mthong sar bzhag la 'di lta bu cig smin mtshams na yod snyam pa byas nas sems 'dzin/ mdor na spyan dbus ma la gsal snang ma skyes kyi bar du bsgom/ spyan g.yas g.yon gnyis la yang de ltar du sems 'dzin/ de nas shangs byi ru'i mdog ltar dmar ba/ snyan shal ring ba/ mchu sgros rnams legs pa/ zhal he zer ba lta bu'i nang na tshems bzhi bcu tham pa dkar la thags bzang ba/ zur bzhir mche ba'i myu gu nas 'bras tsam gtsigs pa/ mgrin par ol gnyer rim pa phyed gsum yod pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pas rked pa yan chad slebs pa/ nu 'bur gnyis mkhrang zhing rgyas pa/ phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pad+ma rā ga'i lcug phran ltar 'jam zhing mnyen pa brkyang bas gri gug 'dzin pa/ g.yon thod pa zla ba ltar dkar ba gyen du phyogs par bzung nas khrag 'dzag pa zhal du gsol ba/ rked pa phra ba/ ro smad rgyas pa zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma mnan pa/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed mnan pa ste rgyan med pa la sems 'dzin par byed/ gnyis pa rgyan can la sems 'dzin pa ni/ de nas dpral bar ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i thod pa sor bzhi pa lnga'i dbu rgyan/

de las 'phyang ba'i rus pa'i drwa ba drwa phyed dang bcas pa/ spyi bor rus pa'i 'khor lo drwa mig so gnyis pa/ snyan gnyis la rus pa'i a long*/ mgul par mgul rgyan drwa mig bcu drug pa/ dpung pa gnyis/ mkhrig ma gnyis/ zhabs gnyis rnams su rus pa'i gdu bu/ rked par 'og pag rus pa'i drwa mig drug cu rtsa bzhi pa/ phrag pa nas brla'i bar du thod skam lnga bcu skra'i skud par brgyus pa'i do shal 'phyang ba/ spyi bor rang chas kyi rigs bdag rnam snang he ru ka dang bcas pa ste sku las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i bar gyi rgyan can rnams la rim pa bzhin du sems 'dzin/ de yang res me ri nas spyan dbus ma'i bar la yang rim bzhin/ res spyan dbus ma nas me ri'i bar la mar rim bzhin sems 'dzin no// de dag re re la'ang gsal na gsal te 'phro bcad/ mi gsal na mi gsal te 'phro bcad/ rnam rtog gi dug dbyung zhes gsungs pa'i gnad dang ma bral bas reg mthong gi mtshan ma thob kyi bar du nyams su len par byed do// gal te lus dkyil bsgom pa dang 'brel na/ gtso mo nas 'khor gyi bar la re re la'ang spyan dbus ma nas me ri'i bar rim bzhin sems 'dzin pa ni bskyed rim gyi dngos gzhi ste/ 'di la brten nas lta ba ngo bo nyid gsum rgyud la skye ba'i phyir nan tan bya'o// gnyis pa rdzogs rim ni/ 'dir zhar la byung ba ste snying ga'i chos 'byung la zur drug yod pa las mdun rgyab gnyis spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa re re g.yon skor du 'khor bar bsams la rlung 'dzin pa'am/ yang na brjod med kyi ngang la bzhag yang gsang gnas nas yar rtsa dbu ma kha dog dmar gsal sba lcam tsam mam/ mda' smyug 'bring po'i tshad tsam pa zhig rtse mo spyi bo nas mdun la gug nas smin mtshams su zug pa/ rtsa ba gsang gnas su zug pa/ dbu ma'i yas snar dga' ba 'khyil pa kha dog dkar po nas 'bras tsam pa g.yon skor du 'khor zhing yod pa de dbu ma'i nang nas mar g.yon du 'khor gyin byung bas snang ba thams cad bde cham cham song*/

dga' ba 'khyil pa de nyid mthar snying gar slebs/ yang dbu ma'i mar snar dga' 'khyil dmar po g.yon skor du 'khor zhing yod pa de dbu ma'i nang nas yar 'khor gyin byung bas snang ba thams cad stong cham cham song*/ de nyid kyang snying gar slebs nas dga' 'khyil gnyis gcig tu phrug chi ler gcig tu 'dres pas/ bde stong zung 'jug gi ngang la dga' 'khyil dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa de nyid g.yon du 'khor ba/ mthar je yal je yal la song ste dbu ma'i stong pa dang gnyis su med par bsams la/ de las skyes pa'i lta ba bde stong zung 'jug gi rgyun bskyangs shing cung zad mnyam par gzhag go /'og gi rtsa dbu ma'i rdzogs rim 'dir bsgom pa'am/ yid bzlas kyi mjug gang rung du bsgom pas chog gsung ngo*/ ༈ /dgu pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor la ngag bzlas dang yid bzlas gnyis las/ dang po ngag bzlas la'ang sngar lus dkyil bsgom pa yin na mi dmigs par bzhag la/ snying ga'i chos 'byung gi nang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi bam̐ yig gi mthar sngags phreng kha dog dmar po g.yon skor du sngar bshad pa ltar bskor nas yod pa de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod/ pho nya gsum gyi byin brlabs dang*/ mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub thams cad 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par byung nas bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ sngags mang nyung ji ltar rigs pa bzla/ de yang sems g.yeng bas bzlas pa la phan yon cher med pas/ gang bzla ba'i sgang la sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig tu dril nas bzlas na phan yon shin tu che ba yin te/ de skad du yang*/ bde mchog sdom 'byung las/ gzhan du mi 'phro'i sems kyi ni// de lta'i tshul gyis bzlas pa bya// yul gzhan blo ni 'gro ba yis// bskal par bzlas kyang 'bras mi 'byin// zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa yid bzlas ni/

gnas der thal tshub med cing*/ lto 'grangs ltogs snyoms pa'i dus su rlung ro rnams lan dgu phrugs su bus pa'i rjes su/ 'og rlung snyan gsan 'bebs pa'i tshul du 'then tsam bya/ steng rlung lus gug byas nas dal bus rngubs rlung rdzogs rjes mchil ma'i rta dang bcas te lte bar bskyur/ de dang dus mnyam du snying ga'i chos 'byung zla ba sngags phreng bam̐ yig dang bcas pa bde ba bskyed pa 'dod na gsang gnas dang*/ mi rtog pa bskyed pa 'dod na lte bar phab/ de nas 'og rlung rdzogs par 'then la rlung bum pa can bzung ste/ sngags rab bdun nam/ tha na'ang gsum la sogs pa yid kyis ci nus su bzlas la/ rlung mi thub na dal bus btang*/ bzlas pa bsdu ba na phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bzung la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab bo/ ༈ /bcu pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ dang po thun mong ba ni gzhung las/ de nas bam̐ yig gi 'od zer gyis sa gsum lus dang lus yi ge rim gyis bsam gyis mi khyab pa la bzhugs pa sngon du 'gro ba de kho na nyid bsgom par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lte ba'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas sogs sgrub thabs kyi nang bzhin te/ de'ang gzugs med khams nam mkha' mtha' yas/ rnam shes mtha' yas/ ci yang med pa/ yod min med min gyi skye mched de gzugs med khams rten dang brten par bcas pa 'od zer sngon po'i rnam par zhu ste/ rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lus kyi stod kyi cha la thim/

gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu bdun te bsam gtan dang po dang*/ gnyis pa dang*/ gsum pa dang*/ bzhi pa rten dang brten par bcas pa 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par zhu nas lus kyi bar gyi cha la thim/ 'dod khams ris drug ste/ ngan song gsum dang*/ mi dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ lha la 'dod lha ris drug ste/ rgyal chen ris bzhi/ sum cu rtsa gsum/ mtshe ma/ dga' ldan/ 'phrul dga'/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed de/ 'dod khams pa rten dang brten par bcas pa 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par zhu nas lus kyi smad kyi cha la thim/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'ang rim gyis 'od du zhu nas snying ga'i bam̐ yig gi nā da'i bar thim/ nā da yang mi dmigs te 'od gsal stong pa nyid spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du 'jog pa ste 'dis ni snod kyi 'jig rten 'jig pa dang*/ bcud kyi sems can 'chi ba sbyangs la/ sbyong byed ni bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor nyams su blangs pas/ sbyangs 'bras ni sangs rgyas chos kyi sku thob par byed do// slar yang stong nyid de'i ngang las rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur ldang nas spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor sogs la 'jug par bya'o// gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa ni zhal las shes zhes gsungs te/ de'i don yang bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag 'di ni/ rnal 'byor ma'i nyams khrid yan lag dang bcas pa yongs su ma rdzogs pa'i slob ma la gnang srol med cing*/ de lta bu'i slob mas kyang gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dang bcas te/ gsol ba nan tan du 'debs pa min pa la mi sbyin par gsungs so// de la'ang sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi gnyis so// dang po ni rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lte ba nas bzung ste lus kyi dbus drang po nas yar rtsa dbu ma sbom phra sba lcag tsam pa/ de'i g.yas na yar ro ma dmar mo/ g.yon na rkyang ma dkar po ste de gnyis mda' smyug 'bring po tsam sum gshibs byas pa spyi bo'i bar du slebs nas tshur mdun la gug pas dbu ma'i rtse mo spyan dbus ma'i thad du zug pa/

gzhan gnyis kyi rtse mo sna g.yas g.yon gnyis la ha re zug pa/ dbu ma'i mas snar rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo rnal 'byor ma mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam pa dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin 'phar la khad pa de las de 'dra ba'i sku chung ngu zhig me stag ltar chad de ro ma'i nang nas yar dmar khyug gis song nas sna bug g.yas kyi sgor slebs/ de las de 'dra ba'i sku phra mo'i rigs/ nyi ma'i zer gyi rdul bas lhag pa tsam chad nas sangs rgyas thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ rlung rngubs pa dang mnyam du tshur 'dus nas sna bug g.yas kyi sgo na yod pa'i rnal 'byor ma la thim/ de nyid sna bug g.yon gyi nang du song rkyang ma'i nang nas mar zhugs nas/ lte ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la thim/ 'di ni sbyang ba zhes bya ba yin pas lan bdun nam lnga gang rung bya/ gnyis pa ni lte ba'i rnal 'byor ma las 'od zer 'phros pas/ lus la phog yan lag thams cad 'od du zhu nas lus po ma la thim/ de 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ rnal 'byor ma de nyid mkha' spyod du rings pa'i tshul gyis nar tsam phyin pas lte ba man chad kyi lus po sku de la thim/ ro rkyang gnyis kyi rtse mo zhabs mthil g.yas g.yon gnyis la thim/ dbu ma'i rtse mo spyi bo la thim/ snying gar byon pas de man chad kyi lus dang rtsa gsum sku la thim/ de bzhin du mgrin par byon pas kyang de ltar thim/ spyi bor byon pas lus po rtsa gsum po dang bcas pa thams cad sku de la thim/ de nyid skar mda' 'phangs pa'am/ rtsal chen gyis mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du blos 'khyud tshad kyi nam mkha'i mthongs su bskyal la 'dzin med du khra ler 'jog slar yang bya nam mkha' nas bab pa bzhin bab ste/ lte ba'i gnas su slebs/ de tsam na lus dang rtsa thams cad kyang sngar bzhin grub par bsam/ 'di la rdzong pa rnams rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho chung zer/

ngor pa byin po rnams rnal 'byor ma'i 'chi chung zer/ gang ltar yang 'di nyid ni gdams pa 'di'i nyams len gyi snying po yin zhing 'pho ba yang 'di ka yin pas dus rgyun du nyams len 'di la gtso bor 'bad par rigs la/ 'di lus sems ya ma bral bar tshogs pa gcig tu 'dres nas 'pho ba yin pas 'pho rab tshe thung ba'i skyon yang med gsungs so/ ༈ /bcu gcig pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni/ spyod lam dngos dang de'i yan lag gnyis las/ dang po ni/ thun mtshams rnams su rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma phyag mtshan spangs pa'i sku dang*/ snang ba thams cad kyang rnal 'byor ma de lta bu'i rnam pa can du gsal pa de'i ngo bo gang du'ang ma grub pa'i stong pa nyid de/ snang stong zung 'jug gi ngang du bskyang ngo*// yang rgyob sod la sogs pa'i sgra bzang ngan rnams kyang 'jigs snang dang log lta mi byed par oṃ gsum ma'i sgrar bsgom zhing*/ de yang grag stong skye 'gags dang bral ba'i ngang du bskyang*/ dran rtog yid la rgyu ba thams cad la yang de'i 'phro mi gcod par de'i ngo bo la cher bltas pas gang du'ang ma grub pa'i stong nyid du dag pa'i tshe/ stong nyid de'i ngang la bskyang*/ dper na zhe sdang lta bu zhig lhang gis skyes pa'i tshe/ de'i ngo bo la cher bltas pas gang du'ang ma grub pa'i stong nyid du thim pa'i tshe/ zhe sdang rang dag la 'gro ba bzhin no// nyams len 'di ni rgyun du ma brjed par gal che ste/ mnyam gzhag tu thugs dam mog mog re byas nas/ rjes thob kun tu tha mal du lus na chos pa'i 'khyer so stor nas 'gro gsungs so// gnyis pa yan lag la/ bza' ba'i rnal 'byor/ phyi rol mchod pa/ sbyin sreg tshes bcu'i mchod pa/ gtor ma'o// dang po ni/ kha zas rnams 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ lag pa gnyis dgang gzar dang dgang blugs/ kha hom khung*/ kha zas bsreg rdzas kyi tshul du byas te longs spyad pas/

lte ba nas me 'bar bas zas kyi snyigs ma rnams tshig dwangs ma rnams snying gar bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du sib sib song bar bsam/ de ltar ma byung na byin gyis brlabs pa'i zas de/ rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i zhal du gsol bas/ zas kyi dwangs ma thams cad snying ga'i bam̐ yig la sib sib thim pas bde chen gyi ye shes brnyes par bsam/ de ltar yang ma byung na byin gyis brlabs pa'i zas rnams kham re re nas rnal 'byor mar gsal ba de/ rang nyid rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i zhal du lha la lha thim pa'i tshul du zos pas kha zas bu lon can du 'gyur ba'i nyes pa las grol lo// gnyis pa ni grong pa'i chos kyis ma gos pa'i bu mo gzhon nu ma bco lnga'am/ bcu gcig gam/ lnga'am/ gsum las mi nyung ba bsags nas ston mo bzang po bshams te/ de rnams rnal 'byor mar bskyed la mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa dpe na gsal pa ltar byed/ 'di ni tshogs myur du rdzogs pa'i thabs yin no// gsum pa ni/ sbyin sreg rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa dpe na gsal ba ltar byed/ bzhi pa ni/ tshogs rdzogs pa'i ched du yar ngo dang*/ sgrib pa sbyang ba'i ched du mar ngo'i tshes bcu la sku tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor/ gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor/ thugs sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor rnams bzhengs/ de dag gi mdun du mchod pa dang gtor ma rnams lag len ltar bshams la/ sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba rnams bya'o// de ltar ma byung na/ tsan+dan dmar po'i phye ma btab pa'i chang gi khu bas maṇ+ḍal lam/ rdo leb bam shing leb/ rigs pa la chos 'byung nyis brtsegs bam̐ yig dang bcas pa bris la sgrub mchod rkyang pa bya/ de ltar yang ma byung na rang gis rgyun du sngags ji tsam bzlas pa'i grangs de sum 'gyur du bzlas pas kyang tshes bcu'i go chod par gsungs so// lnga pa gtor ma ni/ sgrub thabs na ji ltar gsal ba ltar rgyun du bya'o// de ltar rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi nyams len dang*/

tshes bcu rnam pa gnyis kyi mchod pa la brtson par byas pas/ dbang po rab la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mal bud med kyi gzugs kyis mdun du byung ba de ngo shes nas gsol ba btab pas dus de nyid du mkha' spyod du 'khrid par byed do// 'di ni rab bzlas bsgom rkyang pa la brten nas mkha' spyod sgrub pa zhes bya ba yin no// dbang po 'bring la de dag gi steng du sngags 'bru 'bum gsum tsam dang*/ sgrub mchod dang sbrel nas sngags 'bum tsho bzhi tsam sgrub bsnyen gyi tshul du byas/ de yang sin+dhu ra 'bol po yod na thun re re la spos la yol go zhig tu bsogs/ 'bol bo med na thun gsum mam bzhi song nas ye shes pa gshegs gsol byas la gsar pa spo/ sgrub bsnyen grol nas sin+dhu ra rnams bal por skyes pa'i shing laṅka li ya'am/ de ma 'byor na bod 'dir skyes pa'i shing do rgod pa tsam la/ de'i rkang la gad bdar byas te/ spos dang gu gul gyi dud pas bdug de'i sbubs stong gi nang du sin+dhu ra rnams blugs la/ dga' 'khyil bris pa'i kha khebs chung ngus kha bcad/ mi 'dzag par bya ba'i phyir shog bu'am ras kyis de'i phyi nas g.yogs/ yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i dgong mo/ grogs bde mchog gi gzhi bsnyen song ba'i dam tshig can dang bsdongs la/ rnal 'byor dbyug pa gcig kyang khur nas dur khrod du phyin la der dong gru gsum brus nas/ de'i nang du sngar gyi sin+dhu ra snod dang bcas pa bcug la rgyus med kyis ma rig par byas/ de'i khar bsdad nas bdag bskyed bsgom bzlas byed/ 'khris su bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir grogs des rnal 'byor dbyug pa bzung nas/ sum+bha ni 'dren cing yun srod thun tsam du bsdad/ de nas nang du log nas sgrub mchod bzlas pa sogs thugs dam la brtson par byed/ sang nyin dgong mo nas bzung ste snga ma snga ma las rgyun ring bar sdod/ nyi shu bzhi'i dgong mo nam ma langs tshod du sdod/

nyer lnga'i tshes skya rengs nam shar gyi bar du sdod/ de nas rang nyid rnal 'byor ma'i chas su zhugs te/ 'jig rten blos btang ste/ dpral bar sin+dhu ra de nyid kyis dga' ba 'khyil pa'i (par btab la snod mchan khung g.yon du mi mngon par bcangs nas

'di ma dper mi mngon gzhan nas kha bskang bas dpyad 'tshal/ )bskyed rdzogs rnal 'byor dbyug pa thogs te bud med mang po yod pa'i gnas kun tu nyul bas/ bud med gang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub pa yin pa de'i dpral bar sin+dhu ra'i dga' ba 'khyil pa me long gi nang du gzugs brnyan shar ba bzhin 'pho 'ong ba yin pas de nam byung ba dang*/ bud med de la g.yon nas bskor ba byas la gsol ba btab pas/ dus de nyid du mkha' spyod du 'khrid par byed de/ 'di ni 'bring las sbyor dang bzlas bsgom la brten nas mkha' spyod sgrub pa zhes bya ba yin no// de ltar lag len ma grub pa'am/ dbang po tha mas de ltar byas kyang mkha' spyod ma 'grub na/ sgyid lug pa spangs te/ rgyun du bzlas brjod tsam la brtson par bya zhing*/ nam zhig 'chi ltas byung ba'i tshe/ sngar bla mas bstan pa'i 'pho ba'i gdams pa nyams su blangs pas bar do med par mkha' spyod 'grub pa'am/ tha na'ang skye ba brgyud nas mkha' spyod 'grub pa yin gsungs so// de ltar rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi lam gyi rim pas mkha' spyod ma grub pa'am/ sgrub pa po glo bur du tshe'i dus byed pa nye ba na/ 'pho ba'i gdams pa nyams su len pa la/ rje btsun yab yum gnyis ka la brten pa dang*/ yum rkyang la brten pa gnyis las/ dang po la'ang sbyang ba dang*/ las la sbyar ba gnyis las/ dang po la sgrub thabs dang 'brel na/ bzlas pa'i mjug gam bsam mi khyab thun mong ba'i mjug 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang las rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur langs la 'dir 'jug sgrub thabs dang ma 'brel ba'i tshe/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang nas 'pho ba'i dngos gzhi la 'jug ste/ de'ang lte ba nas bzung ste spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga'i bar la rtsa dbu ma drang thal ler song ba'i yas sna tshangs pa'i bu ga dang mnyam pa rgya mthongs kha phye ba lta bu/

sdom phra rtsa ba sba lcag 'bring po tsam/ de nas yar rim pa bzhin du je sbom du song ba'i spyi gtsug gi steng gi nam mkhar pad+ma dang zla nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan ma dang bcas pa'i steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma bde mchog lhan skyes sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ mtha' skor kun tu mkha' spyod kyi dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams kyis sprin gtibs pa bzhin du bskor ba/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro chos srung thams cad spyan drangs nas bla ma yab yum la bstim pas skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur par bsam/ lte ba'i thad kyi dbu ma'i mas sna ru nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor chung ngu dmar 'khyil pa zhig bsam/ de'i steng du rang sems kyi ngo bo rnal 'byaur ma dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam pa/ 'phar la khad 'phur la khad pa zhig bsams la/ spyi bo'i bla ma la mos gus rtse gcig pa'i sgo nas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i dngos// skyabs gnas bla ma mchog dang dbyer med pa'i// dpal ldan he ru ka la gsol ba 'debs// tshe 'dir blo yis thongs par byin gyis rlobs// bdag 'dzin rtsad nas thon par byin gyis rlobs// dgos med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs// lam mchog 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs// 'phyugs med mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol ba btab la/ 'og sgo 'then tsam byas pas rlung gis nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor phul/ de'i rkyen gyis rang sems kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma de rgya mthongs las bye'u chung 'phur ba bzhin du dbu ma'i nang nas yar song*/ spyi gtsug nas thon te/ bla ma yab yum gyi thugs kar thim par bsams la 'dzin med du khra ler 'jog

steng rlung mnan pas bla ma yab yum gyi thugs ka nas mar thon nas/ dbu ma'i mas sne nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du slebs/ yang gsol ba 'debs pa sogs sngar ltar byas la/ bla ma yab yum gyi thugs kar 'pho/ grangs mang nyung ni/ khrid kyi dus su thun re la lan grangs bdun tsam re bya/ sbyong ba'i dus su zhag bdun tsam mtshams bcad la/ grangs bcad dang thun grangs med par sbyangs pas/ 'byangs pa'i rtags ni mgo bo na ba dang*/ spyi gtsug skrangs pa dang*/ khrag thon pa dang*/ sgrub khang la 'ja' zug pa dang*/ me tog gi char bab pa rnams yin gsung*/ nyams len 'di ni dper na khyi bdun gyis dus gcig tu bdes kyang ma brjed pa zhig dgos te/ gzhan du na nam zhig las la sbyor ba'i tshe na nyams su longs pa dka'o// thun de las ldang ba na/ mtha' skor gyi dpa' bo dang dpa' mo thams cad 'od du zhu nas/ bla ma yab yum la thim/ bla ma yab yum gnyis kyang spyi gtsug nas mar snying gar byon/ spyi gtsug rgya mthongs kha phye ba lta bu de 'od dmar po las grub pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje zhig gis bkab pas steng nas chu yang mi 'dzag 'og nas rlung yang mi thar bar bsam/ snying ga'i bla ma yab yum dang*/ lte ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yar mar gzigs res kyis bde ba sgrub pa'i dmigs pa ci rigs pa bya'o// gnyis pa las la sbyar ba ni/ 'di dus rgyun du ni mi bya ste/ 'pho rab tshe thung zhes bya ba yin/ nam zhig nye ba'i 'chi ltas byung ba'i tshe/ spang dag dang*/ tshe sgrub byas la/ ltas log gam ma log blta/ ma log pa na 'pho ba'i nyams len bya ste/ de yang gzhan sbyang ba'i skabs ltar las/ khyad par ni rang sems kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma de bla ma yab yum gyi thugs kar 'phos la/ de'i ngang nas skabs der bla ma yab yum mkha' spyod du gshegs par bsam/ dbugs kyi rgyu ba ma chad kyi bar la/ de lta bu'i dmigs pa yang dang yang du bskyar bar bya'o// 'pho ba gnad du song na bar do med par mkha' spyod 'grub pa yin no// gnyis pa yum rkyang la brten pa'i 'pho ba la'ang*/

gnyis te/ sbyang ba dang las la sbyar ba'o// dang po ni/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lte 'og sor bzhi nas bzung ste/ spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga'i bar la rtsa dbu ma drang thal ler song ba'i yas sna tshangs pa'i bu ga dang mnyam par rgya mthongs kha bye ba lta bu/ sbom phra rtsa ba sba lcag 'bring po tsam la/ de nas yar rim bzhin je sbom du song ba'i spyi gtsug rgya mthongs kha bye ba lta bu'i steng gi nam mkhar pad+ma zla ba nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i steng du ngo bo rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma kun 'dus la/ rnam pa rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal phyag rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku'i rnam pas bzhugs pa la/ mtha' skor kun du mkha' spyod kyi dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams kyis sprin gtibs pa tsam du bskor bar bsam/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs nas spyi bo'i bla ma la bstim pas/ bla ma de skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur par bsam mo// rang gi lte ba'i 'og dbu ma'i mas snar chos 'byung gru gsum chung ngu rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/ gdengs kha che ba gyen du phyogs pa/ de'i nang du rang sems kyi ngo bo bam̐ dmar po ser rdog tsam bsam/ rang gi lus longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad bla ma la mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad du sprul nas 'bul bsam pas/ phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas badz+ra shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā zhes pa'i bar gyis mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyis bstod/ shes shing nus na/ tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i rigs bdag rdo rje chos sogs sam/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/

grub chen nā ro ta pa sogs brgyud 'debs gang rung 'don/ dus rgyun du ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i dngos// skyabs gnas bla ma mchog dang dbyer med pa'i// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la gsol ba 'debs// tshe 'di blo yis thong bar byin gyis rlobs// bdag 'dzin rtsad nas thon par byin gyis rlobs// dgos med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs// lam mchog 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs// 'phyugs med mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes mos gus rtse gcig pas gsol ba btab la/ ngag tu hika ces brjod cing 'og rlung 'then tsam byas pas lte ba'i chos 'byung bsgul/ de'i rkyen gyis rang sems kyi ngo bo'i bam̐ yig de/ rtsa dbu ma'i nang nas rgya mthongs las bye'u chung 'phur ba ltar thogs pa med par yar song*/ tshangs pa'i bu ga nas 'thon te/ bla ma rje btsun ma'i gsang ba nas zhugs te thugs kar sib kyis thim par bsams la/ 'pho bya 'pho byed sogs so sor ma grub par shes pa'i 'dzin med kyi ngang du khra ler 'jog 'og rlung klod cing ka zhes brjod pa dang mnyam du bla ma'i thugs ka nas bam̐ yig bye ste mar byung*/ dbu ma'i mas sna'i chos 'byung gi nang du sngar bzhin slebs par bsam/ yang mchod bstod nus na bya/ gsol 'debs bsdus pa res gsol ba btab ste/ hika ces brjod cing bam̐ yig bla ma'i thugs kar 'phos la 'dzin med du bzhag ka zhes pa dang bla ma'i thugs ka nas bam̐ yig gi rnam pas thon te chos 'byung gi nang du slebs par bsam/ de lta bu grangs mang nyung ni/ khrid kyi skabs su lan bdun tsam dang*/ sbyang ba'i skabs su thun du bcad la zhag bdun la sogs pa rtags ma byung bar du sbyang ngo*// de ltar sbyangs pas rtags ni spyi bo skrangs pa dang*/ za ba dang*/ khrag dang*/ chu ser thon pa/ mgo bo na ba dang*/ sgrub khang du 'ja' zug pa sogs 'byung ngo*// rtags byung nas tshod zin par byas nas gdams pa ma brjed par bya/
