thun de las ldang ba ni/ mtha' skor gyi dpa' bo dang dpa' mo thams cad 'od du zhu nas bla ma la thim/ bla ma rje btsun ma'ang rang gi spyi bo'i tshangs pa'i bu ga nas mar byon snying gar dbu ma'i nang du bzhugs/ spyi gtsug rgya mthongs phye ba lta bu de 'od dmar po las grub pa'i rdo rje rgya gram zhig gis bkab ste/ steng nas chu mi 'dzag 'og nas rlung mi thar bar byas par bsam mo// gal te rtags byung nas tshe sgrub byed par 'dod na rlung bum pa can bzung la/ snying ga'i rje btsun ma 'chi med tshe'i chu rgyun du gyur nas lus thams cad gang bas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsams te/ de lta bu gsum mam bdun sogs byas pas tshe'i bar chad zhi bar 'gyur ro// gnyis pa las la sbyar ba ni/ nam 'chi ltas byung ba'i tshe/ spong dag dang tshe sgrub 'chi bslu byas nas tshe bslu/ de ltar byas kyang 'chi ba ma bslus pa thag chod pa na/ 'pho ba'i nyams len bya ba yin gyis/ dus min du 'phos na lha rnams bsad pa'i nyes par 'gyur te/ sdom 'byung las/ dus thob na ni 'pho bya yi// dus min lha rnams gsod par 'gyur// lha rnams bsad pa tsam gyis ni// mi ni dmyal bar 'tshed par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// de'ang ji ltar 'pho ba'i tshul ni/ gsal gdab pa dang*/ mchod bstod gsol ba 'debs pa rnams gong bzhin byas la/ ngag tu hig ka zhes brjod cing 'og rlung 'then tsam byas pas lte ba'i chos 'byung bsgul/ de'i rkyen gyis rang sems kyi ngo bo'i bam̐ yig de rtsa dbu ma'i nang nas rgya mthong las bye'u chung 'phur ba ltar thogs pa med par yar song*/ tshangs pa'i bu ga nas 'thon te bla ma rje btsun ma'i gsang ba nas zhugs te thugs kar sib kyis thim nas/ bla ma dang yi dam rje btsun ma'i thugs dang rang sems gsum dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres par bsams la/ der 'pho bya 'pho byed 'pho yul thams cad dpyad ngor so sor ma grub par shes pa'i 'dzin med kyi ngang du khra ler 'jog

mar 'bebs pa'i dmigs pa mi bya'o// yang bla ma la gsol 'debs nus sam mi nus kyang mos gus drag po byas la/ bla ma'i thugs kar rang sems kyi ngo bo'i bam̐ yig 'pho ba'i dmigs pa de yang yang dran par bya'o// skabs der bla ma rje btsun ma dag pa mkha' spyod du yud kyis gshegs song bar bsam/ yang sngar bzhin bya ste/ de ltar dbugs kyi rgyu ba ma chad kyi bar du dmigs pa de nyid byas pas bar do med par mkha' spyod 'grub par 'gyur ro// der ni tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa dang*/ longs spyod nam mkha'i mdzod la dbang 'byor pa/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mas chos dngos su ston cing*/ de'i byin gyis brlabs pa la brten nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnams kyang bgrod nus pa zhig yin gsungs so// de ltar 'pho ba'i gdams pa gnyis bsgom pa'i tshul gyi zhal shes bstan zin to// gnyis pa rdzogs rim ni/ spyir rdzogs rim rgyas pa slob dpon nag po spyod pa'i rdo rjes bkral ba mkha' 'gro'i brda'i skad du/ o la pa ti/ bod skad du/ rim pa bzhi pa zhes bya ba dang*/ 'bring po slob dpon dril bu pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma las dngos su gsan pa dril bu rim lnga byin rlabs dang bcas pa dang*/ bsdus pa lū hi pas sha ba ri dbang phyug las gsan pa'i rdzogs rim bsdu ba gsum pa dang*/ rtsa dbu ma'i khrid dang*/ bde mchog dkar po'i khrid rnams zab cing rgya che ba bzhugs kyang*/ de dag las kyang grub chen nā ro ta pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma las dngos su gsan pa'i rtsa dbu ma'i khrid ces bya ba 'di zab la/ de la chos nyid dngos su ston pa'i lam dang*/ brgyud nas ston pa'i lam gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rgya mtsho chen po lta bar 'dod pa'i mi zhig la rgya mtsho ni gting zab pa kha dog sngo ba dang rba rlabs g.yo ba/ nya dang chu srin la sogs pa srog chags mang pos yongs su gang ba'o// zhes brjod kyang*/

'ol spyi tsam las mi 'char la/ dpe de bzhin du bla mas maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du dkar gong sogs kyi brda thabs la brten nas/ chos nyid dngos su bstan kyang don spyi tsam las mi 'char bas/ de las chos nyid brgyud nas ston pa'i lam 'di zab ste rgya mtsho chen po lta bar 'dod pa la/ lam 'di dang 'di zhes bya bar brgyud nas phyin na rgya mtsho mthong ngo zhes brjod pas des kyang ji skad zer ba'i lam la zhugs nas phyin pas/ rgya mtshor slebs pa na/ ji ltar 'dug pa'i sgro 'dogs rnams chod 'ong*/ dpe de bzhin du/ bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams pa 'di rnams nyams su blangs pas/ mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes myur du skye zhing de la brten nas mtshon bya don gyi ye shes myur du skye bas so// de yang dpe gsum gyis don gcig gtan la 'bebs pa ste/ bshan pa srog gi gnad la mkhas pa/ shing mkhan shing gi gnad la mkhas pa/ sgyu ma mkhan 'khrul 'khor gyi gnad la mkhas pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ mi mang pos gros byas nas sems can gcig gsod pa'i tshe/ lag pa dang rkang pa sogs bcad kyang yun ring ba'i bar du mi 'chi/ bshan pa srog gi gnad shes pa gcig gis srog gi rten gang du gnas pa der/ snyung bu lta bu'i mtshon chung ngu gcig brgyab pas de ma thag tu 'chi/ de bzhin du sbyang gzhi gang na gnas kyi gnad mi shes par lam la 'bad pa byas kyang bde chen gyi ye shes bskyed mi nus la/ sbyang gzhi'i gnad shes pa'i dmigs pa phra mos kyang*/ lhan skyes kyi ye shes myur du bskyed nus pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/ rgya gar ḍā ki nī pā tra zhes bya ba'i grong khyer na/ shing sdong po chen po zhig yod pa la/ mon pa s+t+wa re thogs pa mang po dag 'tshogs nas sdong po de'i yal ga sogs bcad pa na/ phyogs gcig nas bcad kyang phyogs gcig nas skye bar 'gyur bas yongs su gcod mi thub/ shing mkhan mkhas pa gcig gis chu rgyu ba'i gnas gang na 'dug btsal ba na/

der bug gu chung ngu zhig phug ste lcags kyi gzer brgyab pas rtsa ba nas 'gyel 'gro'o// de bzhin du gnad mi shes pa'i gdams ngag mang po bsgoms kyang*/ gzung 'dzin je che je che las rnam rtog gcod par mi nus la/ gnad dang ldan pa'i lam zab mo chung ngu res kyang gnyis snang thams cad rang grol du 'gro nus pa yin no// gsum pa ni/ rgyal po bho dza hā ra zhes bya ba'i yul na grong khyer chen po bzhi yod pa/ sgo rnams srung mkhan shing gi mi rigs 'khrul 'khor gyi ral gri thogs pa mang pos 'khrul 'khor rgyun mi 'chad par bskor bas srung ba'i nang*/ rgya mtsho chen por nya dang chu srin sogs du ma rgyug pa'i rnam pa can du yod par der 'jug par 'dod pa na/ 'khrul 'khor gyi gnad mi shes pas ji ltar byas kyang der 'jug mi thub cing*/ 'khrul 'khor gyi gnad shes pa gcig gis skud pa chung ngu gcig bcad pas 'khrul 'khor zhig ste/ der bde blag tu 'jug thub/ dpe de rnams bzhin du gnad dang mi ldan pa'i gdams ngag mang po nyams su blangs pas/ dbu ma'i nang du rlung sems 'jug mi nus/ gnad dang ldan pa'i gdams ngag chung ngu gcig nyams su blangs pas kyang dbu ma'i nang du rlung sems zhugs te myur du bde chen gyi ye shes skye ba yin no// des na gnad dang ldan pa'i gdams pa 'di 'chad pa la/ rgyu chos can 'khor ba'i gnad/ lam bsgom pa'i gnad/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas pa'i gnad dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ 'chi 'pho ba'i tshe/ tshe 'di'i snang ba 'gags te rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa thams cad dbyings su nub nas 'chi ba 'od gsal gyi chos sku 'char/ de'i tshe sngar nas goms 'dris med pa dag lhan skyes kyi ma rig pas bslad de 'od gsal de ngo mi 'phrod/ de las langs nas bar do'i snang ba rnams 'char zhing*/ der 'khrul snang gi sdug bsngal mang pos gdungs pa'i tshe/ skye srid 'tshol 'dod kyi snang ba 'char la/

skye ba len pa'i tshe/ ma'i mngal thag ring po na yod kyang las kyi mig gis mthong nas der 'gro la/ de yang mir skye ba len na/ phor skye rgyu de ma la chags shing pha la sdang*/ mor skye rgyu de la pha la chags shing ma la sdang sems skye zhing*/ pha las thob pa'i khams gsum dang*/ ma las thob pa'i khams gsum ste/ khams drug dang bcas te skye srid du nying mtshams sbyor/ de'i tshe'ang gnyis snang thams cad nub pa'i 'od gsal 'char yang*/ lhan skyes kyi ma rig pas bslad pa la brten nas ngo ma shes pas zhag bdun gyi bar du brgyal ba ltar 'gyur/ de nas chos thams cad zung 'jug tu 'dug snyam nas/ zung 'jug la 'dzin pa zhugs pas/ dbus dang po nas yar rtsa dbu ma rta rnga brgyar gshags pa'i tshad tsam pa gcig grub/ yang stong pa la 'dzin pa zhugs pa las/ g.yas na ro ma tshad de tsam pa gcig grub/ yang gsal ba la 'dzin pa zhugs pa las/ g.yon na yar rkyang ma tshad de tsam pa gcig grub/ de nas pho brang lnga la sogs pa'i lus rim gyis grub ste zla ba dgu song bas btsa' ba'i dus la babs pa'i tshe/ sna sgor las kyi rlung gcig sir byung ba'i rkyen gyis khams dkar dmar gnyis ka gyes te lus po mgo nas 'jug 'og nas skye/ de nas ro rkyang las gyes pa'i rtsa phran ji snyed pa rnams su rlung sems kyi 'gro 'ong byas pa las/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gi rtog pa 'ba' zhig 'char ro// de bas na gnyis med dam bde chen gyi ye shes skye ba'i thabs ni/ rgyud las/ pho nya mchog 'bring tha ma rnams// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyal po'i bya ba shin tu myur ba dang*/ myung ba tsam dang*/ yun ring mo zhig nas bsgrub bya'i bang chen gsum la bang chen rab 'bring tha ma gsum du 'jog pa ltar/ rtsa dbu ma'i nang du rlung sems zhugs na shin tu myur ba nyid du bde chen gyi ye shes skye/ pū dza o a la sogs pa'i yul nyer bzhi'i rtsa rnams su rlung sems zhugs na bde chen gyi ye shes myur ba tsam du skye/

ba spu bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i rtsa rnams su rlung sems zhugs na yun ring mo nas bde chen gyi ye shes rgyud la skye bas na/ rim bzhin pho nya mchog 'bring tha ma rnams 'jog pa las/ 'dir myur lam dbu ma kha 'byed pa la brtson par bya ste/ mtshan brjod las/ ma rig sgo nga'i sbubs 'byed pa// zhes gsungs pa'ang dbu ma'i kha 'byed pa la dgongs so// gnyis pa lam bsgom pa'i gnad la/ chags can pho nya'i lam la dga' ba dang*/ chags bral rnal 'byor pa'i lam la dga' ba gnyis las/ 'dir phyi ma 'chad pa la dbu ma'i nang du rlung sems bsdu tshul dang*/ bsdus nas bsgom tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung*/ lag pa gnyis mnyam gzhag la mthe bong lto sbyar/ sgal tshigs nyi shu rtsa gcig dong rtse ltar bsgreng*/ dpung pa gnyis rgod kyi gshog pa ltar brgyang*/ mig sna rtser phab/ mchu gnyis reg la ma 'byar ba bya/ ma nes og ko non tsam gyis lus gnad legs par bca' ste/ sa paṇa gyis/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor rab bcings na// sems kyi dmigs pa rtse gcig 'grub// ces gsungs pa ltar/ ting nge 'dzin skye ba la lus gnad rang gal che gsungs/ de yang lus drang na rtsa drang*/ rtsa drang na rlung drang*/ rlung drang na khams drang ste/ sems dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu gnas pa 'byung ngo*// de ltar lus gnad rnams bcos rjes/ gsang gnas nas bzung ste/ lus kyi dbus drang po nas yar dbu ma sba lcag 'bring po tsam rtse mo smin mtshams zug pa/ g.yas g.yon gnyis nas yar ro ma dang rkyang ma gnyis gro sog 'bring po'i tshad tsam pa re/ ya mthar spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu gar thug pa drang thal le song ba/ de nas tshur mdun la gug nas ro rkyang gnyis kyi rtse sna bug g.yas g.yon la ha re zug pa/ lte ba'i thad du rtsa de gsum spubs gcig tu gyur pa'i sbubs stong gi nang du ram̐ dmar po ril ma tsam zhig gsal btab la/

rlung ro lan dgu phrugs su bus nas/ 'og rlung yar 'then tsam byas/ steng rlung dal bus rngubs la/ 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum lan gsum gyi sgo nas rlung rdzogs par 'then/ rlung bum can bzung bas lte ba'i ram̐ las me dmar hur hur 'bar bar bsams la/ de'i ngang la 'dzin med du 'jog de yang me 'bar ba ma bsgoms na drod mi skye/ 'dzin med du ma zhig na mu stegs byed kyi gtum mo ltar bde chen gyi ye shes mi skye gsungs so// de ltar yang yang bsgom pas lte ba'i me de ba spu bye ba phrag phyed bzhi'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i rtsa phran rnams kyi nang na yar zhugs pas/ khams snyigs ma thams cad 'tshig dwangs ma thams cad thur du babs nas lte ba'i rtsa sbubs stong ha re ba de thig le kha dog sngo skya'i rnam pa can gyi khams dwangs mas khrig mer gyis khengs par bsam/ gnyis pa bsdus nas bsgom tshul/ rlung lus la btsud pa bde ba sgrub pa'i dmigs pa dang*/ rlung sems la btsud pa stong pa sgrub pa'i dmigs pa gnyis las/ dang po ni ro rkyang gnyis dang*/ dbu ma'i nang gi thig le 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur/ dbu ma rkyang par gnas pa'i smin mtshams su chos 'byung gru gsum rtsa ba phra ba dbu ma'i mas sna la zug pa/ gdengs kha che ba phyir bstan pa/ de'i gdengs kha che ba'i sar thig le kha dog lnga ldan/ kha dog lnga'i 'od zer rnams rang rang ma 'dres par so sor khra khrug ge yod pa la sems gtad de rlung bum pa can bzung*/ de ltar byas pas smin mtshams su na lhang ba'am/ grang lhang lhang ba'i rtags byung na thig le de nyid spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu gar 'phos te/ de nyid ri rtse'i skar ma bzhin 'od khrug khrug pa la sems gtad de rlung bum pa can bzung*/ der yang rtags de ltar byung ba na/ de las thig le dkar po shel dkar bzhu ba'i khu ba lta bu dar dkar gyi skud pa brkyangs pa ltar skya nar byung nas mgrin par slebs/

bde ba skyes par bsams te/ de la sems gtad/ snying ga dang lte ba la yang de bzhin bya/ de nas rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i gsang gnas su chos 'byung gru gsum rtsa ba phra ba dbu ma'i mas snar zug pa/ gdengs kha che ba phyir bstan pa mig bu thal le yod pa'i nang las 'thon te/ mtshan ma pad+ma dmar po kha bye ba lta bu'i ze'u 'bru'i dbus na mar sor phyed gsum tsam phyir nyug ge yod pa la sems gtad de rlung bum pa can bzung*/ bde ba che drag na thig le 'dzag pa'i nyen yod pas/ sor phyed dam phyed dang gnyis sam/ gnyis ji ltar rigs pa bde ba che chung dang bstun nas yar nang du bsdus la/ lhag ma phyir nyug gi yod pa la sems gtad de rlung bum pa can bzung*/ gnyis pa ni/ smin mtshams su chos 'byung thig le bsgom pa dang*/ thig le de spyi bor spos te/ rtags ma byung gi bar du bsgom pa rnams sngar ltar byas pa'i rjes la/ thig le de las 'od kha dog lnga ldan 'ja' 'od kyi rnam pa can spros te/ de phog pas lus rnams rim bzhin 'ja' 'od du gyur/ yang kha dog lnga ldan gyi 'ja' 'od de phar rim bzhin spros pas/ gnas khang lung pa yul phyogs 'dzam bu gling stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad dang*/ mthar nam mkha'i mtha' khyab tshad 'ja' 'od du gyur pa la sems gtad/ thun bsdu bar 'dod na/ 'ja' 'od thams cad rang yal du song ba'i stong nyid de'i ngang la 'dzin med du 'jog pa'am/ yang na phyi'i 'ja' 'od thams cad bsdus nas/ lus 'ja' 'od kyi rnam par gnas pa de la thim/ de yang bsdus nas spyi bo'i thig le la thim par bsams nas/ thig le de la sems gtad de 'dzin med du khra ler 'jog de nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar chos nyid du thim par bsam/ rig pa brjod med du bzhag yang de nas rang nyid skad cig gis lhar gsal ba'am/ yang na nam mkha' nas sprin rdol ba bzhin spyi bo'i thig le de byung*/

de nas rim gyis lha skur langs te sngar bzhin bsgom/ de ltar yun ring bsgoms mthar/ ri rtse lta bu rlung po che sa ru phyin la yang bsgom pas rlung gi reg bya de bzod na de gar bsgom/ mi bzod na nang du log la bsgom/ de bzhin du nyi ma dang me'i tsha gdung che chung rnams la yang de ltar du sbyang*/ yang kun 'dar gsang spyod bya ba dur khrod lta bu'i gnyan sa ru phyin la bsgom pas phar lhongs shing*/ tshur lha 'dre'i zer bzod mi bzod ltas la/ mi bzod na nang du log la bsgom/ bzod na de gar bsgom zhing de nas rim bzhin kun 'dar mngon spyod dang*/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i spyod pa rnams kyang spyad nas/ mkha' 'gros lung bstan pa'i phyag rgya dang pad+ma can dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i nye rgyu la brten nas bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa myur ba nyid du mngon du byed pa yin no// de ltar na bskyed pa'i rim pa bzlas pa dang bcas pa ni/ mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo yin la/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtsa dbu ma ni phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs kyi myur lam khyad par 'phags pa yin pas/ zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa la 'bad par bya'o// rgyun gyi nyams su len tshul ni/ sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin yid bzlas kyi bar byas te/ rtsa dbu ma kha dbye ba nas sems la zhugs pa'i bar ram/ bsdu na ni kha dbye ba ma bsgoms kyang rung*/ zhes 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug pa'i gsung rab las 'byung ngo*// 'dir smras pa/ rab dmar byi ru'i 'khri shing gzhon nur mu tig dang*// zla shel phreng ba'i rgyan du bklubs pas bde chen gyi// ye shes bskyed cing mkha' la spyod par 'khrid bzod na// rgyal yum rdo rje btsun mo'i ngo mtshar rjes su bsngags// der brten myur lam rim gnyis 'khor 'das 'gro ba yi// sgrib pa sbyang phyir rgyu bas lam gsum 'bab kyi rgyun// ngo tshar ma bzod na kra'i grong khyer bros so snyam// yongs 'dzin legs gsungs thob pa'i rgyun yin gzu lum min// tshogs gsum phreng ba blta legs lus phra'i rgyan ma yin// gzhan phan bsam sbyor 'khor ba'i so nam bsgrub phyir min// gang phyir tshul 'di rnam gsal bgyid la spro ba brtas// 'dir 'bad las byung bsod nams mtshar sdug 'gram chang gis// skal bzang blo gros ba ku la yi 'dab ma stong*// rnam par grol bas lung rtogs ge sar dgod pa las// 'jig rten khams su phan bde'i dga' ston 'gyed par shog

/bdag kyang bla med byang chub bar gyi skye nas skyer// dal 'byor rten ldan bla ma lhag pa'i lha mi 'bral// rgyal ba'i dgongs don rjes su mthun pa'i lta sgom spyod// dbang 'byor ston la mkhas pa'i bya ba byed par shog /ces dpal ldan sa skya'i gser chos lugs kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi zab khrid myur lam rkyang mgyogs sgrub pa'i gom stabs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ mgon khang shar gyi bla ma kun dga' phun tshogs pa dang*/ zla rgyud rdzong dpon mgon po dang ldan shod sa skyong mgon po rnam rgyal ba rnams kyis gsung gis zhib gsal byas pa dgos zhes bskul bar snyoms las kyi khur lci bas ring zhig ma grub par/ deng rje sa chen gyi gzhung dang ngor chen yab sras kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang*/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags pas mdzad pa'i khrid yig rnams gzhir byas/ der mi gsal zhing med du mi rung ba rnams 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dang*/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa rnams kyi gsung rab dang*/ bla ma'i gsung sgros rnams kyi kha 'gengs cung zad dang bcas pas brgyan te gsal bar bsdebs pa 'di ni/ mkhan chen lhun grub mtha' can gsum dang*/ mkhas btsun kun dga' bstan 'dzin sangs rgyas dpal bzang po rnams kyi gsung gi bdud rtsi'i skal ba sbom por gyur pa ban+de tshul khrims rin chen nam 'byung du rung ba'i yon tan la smon pa'i btags ming ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha/ dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sde zhes bya bas lcags stag gi bgrang gzhi'i snron zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gnyis par/ lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi shis brjod nyan pas bsrungs pa'i bsti gnas su grub par bgyis pa sarbā r+tha sid+dhaṃ bha wa tu// ༈ /nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi ngag 'don rin chen mgul rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༈ /bla ma mchog dang dbyer med pa'i// mkha' spyod dbang mo la btud de// ches zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi// ngag 'don rin chen mgul rgyan 'bri// de'ang tshogs bsags kyi yul thun mong ba dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can du bskyed pa ni sgrub thabs nyid du gsal la/ 'dir thun mong ma yin pa khrid yig nas bstan pa ltar nyams su blang ba'i tshul gyi ngag 'don ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa sangs rgyas rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can/ sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas rdo rje g.yon dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i cod pan can/ dar gyi na bza' dang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ bdag la dges bzhin du bzhugs pa/ de'i mdun nas brtsams te g.yon skor du sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang nas bzung ste drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma yan gyi brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can du bzhugs pa/ de dag gi mtha' skor du yang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba dang bcas par gyur/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad tshur 'dus/ bla ma thams cad la cha tshang bar thim pas thams cad skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur ces pa'am yang na de nyid tshigs bcad du bsdebs na/ mdun gyi mkha' dbyings seṅges btegs pa'i khrir// pad+ma zla steng sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos// rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje chos// sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis// rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas bsnams// zhabs gnyis mi phyed rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs// gzhon nu bcu drug lor gnas na tshod can// mthon mthing ral pa'i cod pan spyi bor mtshan// dar gyi na bza' rin chen rus pas brgyan// 'od dang 'od zer dkrigs pa'i sku can zhig

/bdag la dgyes pa'i nyams kyis bzhugs par gyur// de mthar brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad kyang*// dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pas bzhugs// gzhan yang yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dang*// nyan thos rang rgyal chos skyong srung ma dang*// nor lha'i tshogs kyis bskor te bzhugs par gyur// kun gyi gnas gsum oṃ dang āḥhūm̐ mtshan// thugs ka'i sa bon 'od zer phyogs bcur song*// rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras// chos skyong nor lha thams cad spyan drangs thim// skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid gyur// ces gsal btab nas/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid sogs/ rdo rje 'chang chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sogs sam/ yang na/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sogs kyis gsol 'debs gang shes bya/ bshams pa'i mchod pa yod na byin gyis brlabs/ med na mi dgos/ oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha sogs nas spar+ṣe kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod de/ gang la chags na nyes kun 'byung ba'i gzhi// sogs nas/ rmongs dang phrag dog zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa'i bar lam zab ltar dang*/ rang sems bam̐ yig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// dbu ma'i lam brgyud tshangs bug nas 'thon te// rtsa ba'i bla mar zhal sbyor bzhugs pa yis// phan tshun bde ba chen pos mnyes par gyur// rang sems ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor mas// rang gi tha mal phung po la gzigs pas// che zhing snum la tsho bar 'dug pa de// sngar nas 'di 'dra'i lus kun don med song*// da lan don can bya 'o snyam dgongs nas// phung po'i rtsar byon gri gug rnon po yis// tha mal lus su snang ba'i mgo bo yi// ya thod bcad nas mdun du bkan te bzhag /gang de ches dkar yangs pa'i snod gyur pa// rkang g.yon g.yas dang khog smad nang khrol dang*// khog stod lag gnyis mgo bo'i lhag ma bcas// de nang bskyur bas sha khrag rgya mtshor gyur// oṃ las chos dbyings sogs nas// skyabs gnas kun 'dus zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// thar pa'i lam ston zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// brgyud pa'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// yi dam lha tshogs zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// sangs rgyas byang sems zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// nyan thos rang rgyal zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// chos srung nor lha'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po 'di// bzhes nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// mchod pa'i lha rnams rtsa ba'i bla ma yi// thugs kar thim pas thugs rgyud zag med kyi// bde ba chen pos yongs su mnyes gyur te// mchog tu dges pa'i nyams dang ldan par gyur// bdud rtsi'i lhag ma rigs drug sems can rnams// lha ru gsal ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// chags sdang rmongs gsum rnam rtog zhi ba dang*// byang chub sems 'byongs sangs rgyas thob par shog

/skabs 'dir maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma ci nus dang skabs skabs su so bdun ma yang 'bul/ mthar shes shing nus na gang gi mchod rdzas sogs dang*/ deng nas byang chub sogs kyang brjod/ de nas/ rje btsun mchog gi mtha' skor bzhugs pa yi// sogs nas/ dbyings kyi rol pas bla ma'i thugs kar thim// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag la dbang bskur stsol// bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od dkar po// oṃ gyi gzugs byung rang gi dpral bar thim// bum pa'i dbang thob lus kyi dri ma dag /sku yis byin brlabs sprul sku'i sa bon bzhag /bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od dmar po// āḥyig gzugs byung rang gi mgrin par thim// gsang ba'i dbang thob ngag gi dri ma dag /gsung gis byin brlabs longs sku'i sa bon bzhag /bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od sngon po// hūm̐ gi gzugs byung rang gi snying gar thim// gsum pa'i dbang thob sems kyi dri ma dag /thugs kyis byin brlabs chos sku'i sa bon bzhag /bla ma'i yi ge gsum las 'od sna tshogs// 'bru gsum gzugs byung rang gi gnas gsum thim// bzhi pa'i dbang thob sgrib pa bag chags dag /kun gyis byin brlabs ngo bo nyid skur gyur// bla ma mchog la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// khyed kyis bdag rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma de 'od zer dmar po bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur nas rang la thim par bsam mo// rang gi snying gar e yig nyis brtsegs sogs dkyus la 'jug go /zhes nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi ngag 'don rin chen mgul rgyan zhes bya ba 'di ni bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal sogs don gnyer gyis bskul ngor/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa bud+dha la k+ṣ+mis mdzad pa'i ku sā li'i tshogs bsags tshigs bcad ma gzhir bzhag nyams su blang bde bar ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng du bris pa dge'o//

༈ /nā ro mkha' spyod skabs kyi tshogs bsags bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi ngag 'don nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /gang la brten nas mthong chos sa bon nas// sku bzhi'i snye ma g.yur du za ba'i bar// ci 'dod lag rtser sbyin mchog rdo rje yi// slob dpon rtag tu bsnyen pa'i rnal 'byor 'bri// 'dir nā ro mkha' spyod skabs kyi tshogs bsags bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi ngag 'don tshigs su bcad par bsdebs pa la/ zur du nyams su len na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang*/ sgrub thabs dang 'brel ba'i tshe rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas kyi rjes thogs su/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rin chen seṅge'i khri// sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba'i gdan steng du// skyabs gnas kun 'dus drin chen chos kyi rje// rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje chos// sku mdog dmar po rdo rje dril bu bsnol// bgrang bya bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho can// sna tshogs dar dang rin chen rus pas brgyan// zhabs gnyis mi phyed rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs// de mthar brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad ni// dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pas bskor// gzhan yang yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems// nyan thos rang rgyal chos skyong srung ma dang*// nor lha'i tshogs kyis bskor te bzhugs par gyur// kun gyi gnas gsum 'bru gsum yi ges mtshan// hūm̐ las 'od 'phros bla ma yi dam sogs// skyabs yul ma lus spyan drangs dbyer med thim// zhes pas gsal btab nas/ gang gi drin gyis lhan skyes bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba'i yon tan gter// 'dren mchog bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad+mar spyi bos 'dud// ces dang brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs gang rung 'don/ de ltar mi nus ba'am bsdu na/ smin byed dbang dang byin rlabs rjes su gnang*// ches zab khrid dang rgyab rten lung gi chos// dngos dang brgyud pas legs 'doms bla ma'i tshogs// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol ba btab/

zur du nyams su len na bshams pa'i mchod pa rnams byin rlabs spyi ltar byas la/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā'i bar re re'i mgor sbyar gyis mchod la/ gang la chags na nyes kun 'byung ba'i gzhi// longs spyod gnyen dang mdza' bshes ji snyed pa// rje btsun bla ma mchog la dbul bar bgyi// 'dod chags rnam rtog zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// mthong thos reg pas zhe sdang 'phel ba'i gzhi// gnod byed dgra 'drer snang ba je snyed pa// de kun bla ma mchog la dbul bar bgyi// zhe sdang dbyings su zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// tshe rabs du ma grangs med mar byas kyang*// las nyon dbang gis gnyen 'brel ma shes pa// bar ma'i 'gro rnams khyed la dbul par bgyi// gti mug phrag dog zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes zhen pa spang ngo*// rang sems ngo bo snying ga'i rnal 'byor ma// dbu ma'i lam brgyud tshangs pa'i sgo nas thon// rtsa ba'i bla mar zhal sbyor bzhugs pa yis// phan tshun bde ba chen pos mnyes par gyur// slar yang rang sems mkha' spyod dbang mo yis// rang gi tha mal phung po la gzigs pas// che zhing snum la tsho bar 'dug pa mthong*// sngar yang 'di 'dra'i lus kun don med song*// da lan don can bya 'o dgongs nas ni// phung po'i rtsar byon gri gug rnon po yis// tha mal lus su snang ba'i mgo bo yi// ya thod bcad de thod pa'i sgyed pur btsugs// gang de ches dkar yangs pa'i snod gyur par// rkang g.yon g.yas dang khog smad nang khrol dang*// khog stod lag gnyis mgo bo'i lhag mar bcas// de nang bskyur bas sha khrag rus pa'i gter// 'og nas me 'bar thod pa'i nang rdzas rnams// bskol zhing zhu ba kha dog dri ro bcud// phun tshogs bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor oṃ āḥhūm̐// snying ga'i bam̐ las yid 'phrog lha mo'i gzugs// grangs med spros pas thod pa'i bdud rtsi las// bcus nas blangs te 'bul ba'i mchod pa 'di// bdag la brtse ba'i thugs kyis nyer dgongs nas// dgyes pa chen pos bzhes par mdzad du gsol// drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin can// 'khor lo'i mgon po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// skyabs gnas kun 'dus zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

dngos su bshams pa'i nang mchod yod pa'i tshe mtheb srin gyis 'thor/ brgyud pa'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// yi dam lha tshogs zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// sangs rgyas byang sems zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// nyan thos rang rgyal zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// chos srung nor lha'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// dgyes par rol nas thugs rgyud zag med kyi// bde ba chen pos yongs su mnyes gyur nas// bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad la// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// gzhi bdag gnas bdag rigs drug sems can rnams// yi dam lhar gsal zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// chags sdang gti mug rnam rtog zhi ba dang*// byang chub sems 'byongs sangs rgyas thob gyur cig /de nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/ bdag gzhan lus dang longs spyod dge bar bcas// khor yug lcags ris yongs bskor dbyig 'dzin mar// lha gnas grangs med bkod legs lhun po dang*// gser gyi ri bdun rol pa'i chu gter dang*// dge bcu tshang ba'i gling dang gling phran brgyad// dpag bsam 'dod 'jo'i ba mo ma rmos 'bras// nyi zla lha mi'i dpal 'byor maṇ+ḍal la// 'khor lo'i mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i dpa' bo yis// bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug mda' gzhu legs sbyar nas// sgrib gnyis dgra bo lhag ma med bcom nas// zung 'jug sku bzhi'i rgyal srid thob par mdzod// ces dang*/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun pa dang*/ sa gzhi spos byug dang*/ so bdun can sogs ci nus 'bul bas bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags/ mtha' skor bzhugs pa'i mchod yul thams cad ni// dbyings kyi rol pas rtsa ba'i bla mar thim// sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// bdag la dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol// bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od dkar po// oṃ gyi gzugs byung rang gi dpral bar thim// bum pa'i dbang thob lus kyi dri ma dag

/sku yis byin brlabs sprul sku'i sa bon gzhag /bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od dmar po// āḥyi gzugs byung rang gi mgrin par thim// gsang ba'i dbang thob ngag gi dri ma dag /gsung gis byin brlabs longs sku'i sa bon gzhag /bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od sngon po// hūm̐ gi gzugs byung rang gi snying gar thim// gsum pa'i dbang thob yid kyi dri ma dag /thugs kyis byin brlabs chos sku'i sa bon bzhag /bla ma'i yi ge gsum las 'od sna tshogs// 'bru gsum gzugs byung rang gi gnas gsum thim// bzhi pa'i dbang thob sgrib pa bag chags dag /kun gyis byin brlabs ngo bo nyid skur gyur// ces pas dbang bzhi blangs/ slar yang 'khor lo'i mgon po mnyes bzhin du// bde ba chen por zhu nas bdag la thim// bdag gi sgo gsum dbyer med 'dres pa'i ngang*// bla ma sku bzhi lhun grub rang zhal skyong*// zhes bla ma rang la bstims nas de kho na nyid kyi ngang du ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag go /de las ldang ba na/ sgrub thabs dang 'brel ba'i tshe/ rang gi snying gar e yig nyis brtsegs sogs la 'jug zur du nyams su len pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus phyi yi bla ma dang*// sems nyid 'od gsal nang gi bla ma dang*// rang bzhin stong gsal don gyi bla ma sogs// dbyer med snying po'i bla mar rtogs par shog /dge ba 'di yis bdag sogs sems can rnams// dngos grub 'byung gnas dpal ldan bla ma la// lhag pa'i lha ru shes pa'i mos gus kyis// dbang dang dngos grub rtag tu len par shog /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma sogs/ bsngo ba smon lam gang shes brjod do// dpal ldan nā ro ta pa'i thugs kyi bcud// zab lam bsgom pa'i rim pa ngag 'don du// bstar ba'i dge bas don yod rnam pa bzhis// rtag tu dpal ldan bla ma mnyes byed shog /ces nā ro mkha' spyod skabs kyi tshogs bsags bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi ngag 'don nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/

ldan yul shod kyi chos ldan sa 'dzin dbang po mgon po rnam rgyal gsung gis bskul ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis sug bris bgyis pa dge bar gyur cig/ ༈ /rje tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i nā ro mkha' spyod kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi kha skong ni// ༈ /bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i bstan 'dzin blo gsal dang*// zhes pa'i rjes su/ bka' babs kun gyi mnga' bdag mkhyen brtse'i dbang*// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// chos gter 'chang ba rje btsun rta ra ba// chos bzhin smra mkhas ngag dbang chos kyi grags// chos kyi spyan yangs dbang phyug rab brtan la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// mkha' spyod thabs mchog kun dga' bsod nams dpal// mkha' mnyam 'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang*// mkha' spyod grub pa bsod nams mtha' yas la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// rgyud don 'chad mkhas bsod nams dbang phyug zhabs// rgyud sde'i mnga' bdag bstan pa rab rgyas dang*// rgyud don legs gzigs bsod nams chos 'phel la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// bstan 'dzin yongs kyi ded dpon sangs rgyas bstan// bstan pa'i snang byed sangs rgyas dpal bzang zhabs// bstan don lhur byed rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// dal 'byor gru chen sogs dang sbrel lo// zhes nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs khrid bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi kha skong 'di'ang ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// ༈ /mkha' spyod yum la brten pa'i 'pho ba'i gdams pa mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i myur lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /dpal ldan bla ma 'khor lo sdom pa dang*// rdo rje'i btsun mo rnal 'byor mar btud de// nā ro ta pa las brgyud 'pho ba yi// gdams pa zab mo rnam gsal yi ger 'god// 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la brten pa'i 'pho ba'i gdams pa nyams su len pa'i tshul la/

bdag bskyed rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi nyams len dang 'brel na bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor gyi nā da yang mi dmigs te 'od gsal stong pa nyid du gyur zhes pa yan chad nyams su blangs nas/ slar yang rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rgyan dang phyag mtshan spangs pa'i skur gyur zhes gsal gdab cing 'pho ba'i nyams len la 'jug bdag bskyed dang ma 'brel na/ skyabs 'gro ci nus byas la/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral nas bla na med pa'i byang chub la dgod par bya/ de'i ched du 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bgyi'o zhes lan gsum brjod/ dngos gzhi la gsum/ gsal gdab pa/ sbyang ba/ las la sbyar ba'o// dang po gsal gdab pa ni/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byaur mar gsal ba'i lte 'og sor bzhi nas bzung ste spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga'i bar la rtsa dbu ma drang thal ler song ba'i yas sna tshangs pa'i bu ga dang mnyam par rgya mthongs kha bye ba lta bu/ sbom phra rtsa ba sba lcag 'bring po tsam la/ de nas yar rim bzhin je sbom du song ba'i spyi gtsug rgya mthong kha phye ba lta bu'i steng gi nam mkhar pad+ma zla ba nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i steng du ngo bo rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma kun 'dus la/ rnam pa rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal phyag rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku'i rnam pas bzhugs pa la/ mtha' skor kun tu mkha' spyod kyi dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams kyis sprin gtibs pa tsam du bskor bar bsam/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs nas spyi bo'i bla ma la bstim pas/ bla ma de skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur par bsam mo// rang gi lte ba'i 'og dbu ma'i mas snar chos 'byung gru gsum chung ngu rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/

gdeng kha che ba gyen du phyogs pa/ de'i nang du rang sems kyi ngo bo bam̐ dmar po ser rdog tsam bsam/ gnyis pa sbyong ba ni/ rang gi lus longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad bla ma la mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad du sprul nas 'bul bsam pas/ phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas badz+ra shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā zhes pa'i bar gyis mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyis bstod/ shes shing nus na/ tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i rigs bdag rdo rje chos// sogs sam/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i/ rdo rje 'chang chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// grub chen nā ro ta pa sogs brgyud 'debs gang rung 'don/ dus rgyun du ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i dngos// skyabs gnas bla ma mchog dang dbyer med pa'i// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la gsol ba 'debs// tshe 'di blo yis thongs par byin gyis rlobs// bdag 'dzin rtsad nas thon par byin gyis rlobs// dgos med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs// lam mchog 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs// 'phyugs med mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes mos gus rtse gcig pas gsol ba btab pa/ ngag tu hika ces brjod cing 'og rlung 'then tsam byas pas lte ba'i chos 'byung bsgul/ de'i rkyen gyis rang sems kyi ngo bo'i bam̐ yig de rtsa dbu ma'i nang nas rgya mthongs las bye'u chung 'phur ba ltar thogs pa med par yar song*/ tshangs pa'i bu ga nas 'thon te/ bla ma rje btsun ma'i gsang ba nas zhugs te thugs kar sib kyis thim par bsams la/ 'pho bya 'pho byed sogs so sor ma grub par shes pa'i 'dzin med kyi ngang du khra ler 'jog 'og rlung klod cing ka zhes brjod pa dang mnyam du bla ma'i thugs ka nas bam̐ yig bye ste mar byung*/

dbu ma'i mas sna'i chos 'byung gi nang du sngar bzhin sleb par bsam/ yang mchod bstod nus na bya/ gsol 'debs bsdus pa res gsol ba btab ste/ hig ces brjod cing bam̐ yig bla ma'i thugs kar 'phos la 'dzin med du bzhag ka zhes pa dang bla ma'i thugs ka nas bam̐ yig gi rnam pas thon te chos 'byung gi nang du slebs par bsam/ de lta bu grangs mang nyung ni khrid kyi skabs su lan bdun tsam dang sbyang ba'i skabs su thun du bcad la zhag bdun la sogs pa rtags ma byung bar du sbyang ngo*// rtags ni spyi bo skrangs pa/ za ba/ khrag dang chu ser thon pa/ mgo bo na ba dang*/ sgrub khang du 'ja' zug pa sogs 'byung ngo*// rtags byung nas tshod zin par byas nas gdams pa mi brjed par bya/ thun de las ldang ba na/ mtha' skor gyi dpa' bo dang dpa' mos thams cad 'od du zhu nas bla ma la thim/ bla ma rje btsun ma'ang rang gi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas mar byon/ snying gar dbu ma'i nang du bzhugs/ spyi gtsug rgya mthongs bye ba lta bu de 'od dmar po las grub pa'i rdo rje rgya gram zhig gis bkab ste/ steng nas chu mi 'dzag 'og nas rlung mi thar bar byas par bsam mo// gal te rtags byung nas/ gnyis pa tshe sgrub byed par 'dod na/ rlung bum pa can bzung la/ snying ga'i rje btsun ma 'chi med tshe'i chu rgyun du gyur nas lus thams cad gang bas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsams te/ de lta bu gsum mam bdun sogs byas pas tshe'i bar chad zhi bar 'gyur ro// gsum pa las la sbyar ba ni/ nam 'chi ltas byung ba'i tshe/ spong dag dang tshe sgrub dang 'chi bslu byas nas tshe bslu/ de ltar byas kyang 'chi ba ma bslus pa thag chod pa na 'pho ba'i nyams len bya ba yin gyis/ dus min du 'phos na lha rnams bsad pa'i nyes par 'gyur te/ sdom 'byung las/ dus thob na ni 'pho bya yi// dus min lha rnams gsod par 'gyur// lha rnams bsad pa tsam gyis ni// mi ni dmyal bar 'tshed par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// de'ang ji ltar 'pho ba'i tshul ni/

gsal gdab pa dang*/ mchod bstod gsol ba 'debs pa rnams gong bzhin byas la/ ngag tu hig ka zhes brjod cing 'og rlung 'then tsam byas pas lte ba'i chos 'byung bsgul/ de'i rkyen gyis rang sems kyi ngo bo'i bam̐ yig de rtsa dbu ma'i nang nas rgya mthongs las bye'u chung 'phur ba ltar thogs pa med par yar song*/ tshangs pa'i bu ga nas 'thon te/ bla ma rje btsun ma'i gsang ba nas zhugs te thugs kar sib kyis thim nas bla ma dang yi dam rje btsun ma'i thugs dang rang sems gsum dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres par bsams la der 'pho bya 'pho byed 'pho yul thams cad dpyad ngor so sor ma grub par shes pa'i 'dzin med kyi ngang du khra ler 'jog mar 'bebs pa'i dmigs pa mi bya'o// yang bla ma la gsol ba 'debs nus sam mi nus kyang mos gus drag po byas la bla ma'i thugs kar rang sems kyi ngo bo'i bam̐ yig 'pho ba'i dmigs pa de yang yang dran par bya'o// skabs rer bla ma rje btsun ma dag pa mkha' spyod du yud kyis gshegs song bar bsam/ yang sngar bzhin bya ste/ de ltar dbugs kyi rgyu ba ma chad kyi bar du dmigs pa de nyid byas pa la bar do med par mkha' spyod 'grub par 'gyur ro// de lta bu'i dmigs pa 'di ni khyi bdun gyis dus gcig la ded kyang mi brjed pa cig dgos par gsungs te/ glo bur 'chi rkyen ji ltar 'byung mi nges pa'i don gyi phyir ro// de ltar mkha' spyod yum rkyang dang*// rjes 'brel myur lam rnam gsal 'di// bgyis pa'i dge bas lus can rnams// mkha' spyod rig 'dzin 'grub phyir bsngo// zhes mkha' spyod yum la brten pa'i gdams pa mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i myur lam zhes bya ba 'di'ang dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyi ngor/ 'di'i khrid yig dang mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang po sogs mkhas grub rnams kyi gsung rgyun gyis brgyan te ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis 'phral du bris pa dza yan+tu//

༈ /dpal sa skya'i gser chos lugs kyi nā ro mkha' spyod la brten pa'i 'pho ba 'od gsal bar dor bcas pa'i nyams len zab gnad btus pa'i bdud rtsi zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༈ /bla med gsang mtha'i nye lam sa skya pa'i// gser chos mkha' spyod dga' ma'i rnal 'byor brten// tshe gcig mkha' spyod rig pa 'dzin 'dod pas// myur lam gdams pa'i them skas 'dir zhugs shig /sdug bsngal 'byung gnas tshe 'di'i phun tshogs la// nags tshal 'tshig pa'i bya bzhin ma chags par// bde ba'i go 'phang 'gro bar 'dod pa'i blo// skom pa chu la snyegs ltar spro ba bskyed// skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi ltar sngon 'gro bas// dngos gzhi'i sbyang dang las sbyar dang po ni// rang nyid yi dam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// snang stong 'ja' lus lta bu'i skur gyur pa'i// lte 'og gsor bzhi nas brtsams spyi bo'i bar// dbu ma 'od kyi sbu gu mda' smyug tsam// shel gyi ka ba btsugs ltar yod pa yi// mas sner chos 'byung dmar po chung ngu'i steng*// rang gi rnam shes ngo bo bam̐ yig dmar// ril ma tsam zhig dmar 'od 'phros par bsam// spyi gtsug dbu ma rgya mthongs ltar phye ba'i// nam mkhar pad+ma zla ba nyi ma dang*// 'jigs byed dus mtshan bsgyel ba'i gdan steng du// ngo bo sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma nyid// rnam pa rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byaur ma// sku mdog dmar mo zhal phyag rgyan rdzogs sku// dag pa mkha' spyod gnas su gzigs nas bzhugs// de mthar mkha' spyod dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs// sprin ltar 'thibs pas yongs su bskor bar gyur// de dag thugs ka'i sa bon 'od zer 'phros// phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras// ma lus spyan drangs spyi bo'i bla mar thim// skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid gyur// de la rang lus longs spyod dge ba rnams// mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos dang*// mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo sogs// grangs med sprul pa'i mchod pas mnyes par bya// oṃ badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyis bstod/ gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag /skyabs gnas bla ma mchog dang dbyer med pa'i// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la gsol ba 'debs// tshe 'di blo yis thongs bar byin gyis rlobs// dgos med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs// lam mchog 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs// 'phyugs med mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// de ltar mos gus drag pos gsol btab mthar// 'og rlung bskyod pas lte 'og chos 'byung bsgul// rnam shes ngo bo bam̐ gyi yi ge de// dbu ma'i lam nas rgya mthong bya 'phur ltar// spyi bo'i gtsug nas bla ma rnal 'byor ma'i// thugs kar thim pas bla ma yi dam dang*// rang sems ro gcig 'dres pa'i klong nyid du// hi zhes brjod cing bla ma'i thugs kar 'pho/

dus rgyun sbyang bya'i tshe 'di ltar kho na bya'o/ /ka zhes brjod pas bla ma'i thugs ka nas// bam̐ yig mar byung chos 'byung nang gnas bsam// slar yang gsal 'debs bla ma'i thugs kar 'pho// mar la 'bebs pa 'di gnyis yang nas yang*// 'byongs rtags ma byung bar bya de nas bzhag /thun mtshams spyi bo'i bla ma snying gar byon// spyi gtsug sgo ni sna tshogs rdo rjes bkag /'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo ma tshogs kyis// zhes sogs smon lam gang shes brjod par bya'o// nam zhig nges par 'chi dus bab pa'i tshe// rang sems ro gcig 'dres pa'i klong nyid du// zhes pa yan chad sngar dang 'dra bar byas// hi ka zhes brjod bla ma'i thugs kar 'pho// bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med bsres// mar la phab pa'i dmigs pa mi bya zhing*// slar yang lte 'og rang sems bam̐ yig de// hi ka zhes brjod bla ma'i thugs kar 'pho// de 'dra dbugs rgyu ma chad bar du bya// skabs rer spyi bo'i bla ma rang sems bcas// dag pa mkha' spyod gnas su gshegs par bsam// de ltar nyams blangs 'pho ba gnad song na// sangs rgyas zhing ngam mkha' spyod rig 'dzin skye// de ni lus dngos lhag pa'i lha yi gzugs// tshe ni nyi zla gnas kyi bar 'tsho ba// sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku las chos nyan cing*// longs spyod nam mkha'i mdzod las 'byung bar bshad// ci ste 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor ma thebs na// 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku 'char ba'i tshul// dam pa dang po'i rgyud las 'di skad du// lus can rnams ni 'chi ba de yi tshe// bdud rtsi zla ba thur du 'bab pa dang*// zla mtshan nyi ma yang ni gyen du ldog /rnam shes srid pa'i mtshan nyid can gsungs pa// dkar cha spyi bor gnas pa thur du bab// stong pa dkar lam zla ba shar 'dra 'byung*// dmar cha lte bar gnas pa can du ldog /stong chen dmar lam nyi ma shar 'dra 'byung*// thig le dkar dmar snying gar 'dus pa las// shin tu stong pa nag lam mun ltar 'thibs// de mthar thams cad stong pa zhes bya ba// rnam par shes pa 'od gsal la thim nas// yod med skye 'gag spros pa kun bral ba'i// 'od gsal stong nyid mchog gi ting 'dzin skye// de tshe sngar nas goms pa'i 'od gsal dang*// gzhi la gnas pa'i 'od gsal 'dres pa la// 'od gsal ma bu mjal ba zhes bya ste// 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku shar ba na// rang ngo shes par byas la de'i ngo bo// zung 'jug blo 'das bskyangs pas don chen 'grub// de la de bzhin nyid kyi 'pho ba 'am// 'chi ba chos skur 'tshang rgya zhes bya'i dus// de las langs nas lus sems so sor 'bral// bar do'i 'khrul snang sna tshogs shar gyur na// de tshe bar do'i ngo sprod 'di ltar zung*// bar dor rig pa'i lus rten med pa'i phyir// grib ma rjes dang nyi zla'i snang ba med// yid kyi lus can kun tu thogs med rgyu// bza' ba dri la zhen pa ma spangs phyir// dri yi zas dang skye srid 'tshol don du// phyogs kun rgyu bas 'byung bzhi'i rlung 'khrugs te// sa rlung 'khrugs pas ri bo grum pa'i sgra// chu rlung 'khrugs pas rgya mtsho 'chol ba'i sgra// me rlung 'khrugs pas dus mtha'i me 'bar sgra// rlung gi rlung 'khrugs bskal pa 'jigs dus kyi// rlung gi sgrar mtshungs 'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi dang*// nyon mongs dug gsum rang gzugs dmyal ba dang*// yi dwags dud 'gro'i nyam nga'i g.yang sa gsum// mthong ba'i rkyen gyis 'jigs skrag byung ba'i tshe// bar do'i 'khrul snang yin par shes gyis la// bla ma dkon mchog gsum po dran bya zhing*// sngar nas goms pa'i bskyed rdzogs rnal 'byor ram// rang gzhan cir snang thams cad rnal 'byor ma// snang stong dbyer med 'ja' lus lta bur sgoms// sgra rnams grag stong gnyis med sngags kyi sgra// dran bsam rig stong dbyer med lha yi thugs// gnyis su med pa'i ye shes chen por skyongs// bar do'i shes pa sngar las ches gsal zhing*// dran myur ye shes bsgom pa stobs che phyir// 'khyer so gsum po rtag tu dran byas pas// bar dor longs skur 'tshang rgya bgyid dus so// smras pa/

srid par skyes dgu mi rtag brtan pa med// de yang nam 'chi nges med tshul shes pas// dge sbyor kun gyi snying po 'chi dus su// dgos don gdams pa ma brjed snying la chongs// su zhig 'da' ka bar dor phan pa'i mchid// zab gnad btus pa'i bdud rtsi byin pa'i dge /'gro tshogs thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i srog /'tsho byed chos kyi sman pa 'thob phyir bsngo// zhes pa dpal sa skya'i gser chos lugs kyi nā ro mkha' spyod la brten pa'i 'pho ba 'od gsal bar dor bcas pa'i nyams len zab gnad btus pa'i bdud rtsi zhes bya ba 'di ni/ don gnyer rnams kyi ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i zegs ma zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༈ /'khor lo'i mgon po bla ma dang*// lhag pa'i lha mchog dbyer med pa// gtsug tu mchod nas phan byed kyi// gdams pa'i zil mngar cung zad 'bri// de'ang 'dir zab lam don du gnyer ba'i bu slob nas/ bdag cag nam zhig 'chi dus blo gtad ci bgyi'i gdams pa tshig lhug pa go bde ba zhig dgos zhes par/ spyir dal 'byor gyi lus rten lan gcig thob pa'i skabs 'dir snying po blang bya'i gtso bo ni tshang la ma nor ba'i lam la ci nus kyis 'bad pa'i sgo nas lam gyi yon tan rgyud la bskyed cing nus pas chos pa rab 'chi ba la mi skrag pa'i gdeng nang nas skye ba 'byung bar bshad la/ de ltar ma byung bar du 'bad/ sngar nas yi dam gyi lha gang gi'ang rnal 'byor la goms 'dris byas mthar/ 'chi ltas sogs byung ba'i tshe 'chi bslu'i rigs bya/ des kyang ma bslus par dus la bab nges pa na/ rnam par shes pa spyi bo'i gtsug nas/ bla ma yi dam rang sems gsum dbyer med du bsres nas 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor rang rang gi gzhung nas 'byung ba ltar gyis/ las la sbyar bas bar do med par mkha' spyod rig 'dzin sogs 'grub bo// gal te 'pho dus 'das pa'am dus der 'pho ba ma thebs par gyur kyang*/

spyi gtsug gi khams dkar cha thur du bab pas/ snang ba thams cad dkar lam zla ba shar ba lta bu 'byung*/ lte ba nas dmar cha gyen la log pas/ snang ba thams cad dmar lam nyi ma shar ba lta bu 'byung*/ de gnyis snying gar 'dzom nas kha sbyor gyur pa'i tshe nag lam srod kyi mun pa stug po lta bu'i snang ba 'char zhing*/ de'i tshe dug gsum gyi rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog rnams 'gags te rgyud la nyon mongs mi skye/ de'i dus na nag lam gyi mthar sems zin pa byung na 'od gsal don dam pa'i ye shes 'char ba 'byung ste/ de ni sems can thams cad la 'byung ba yin yang*/ ngo ma shes pas nyen pa yin la/ sngar lam la goms 'dris yod pas 'od gsal de la yod med yin min sogs kyi spros pa'i mtha' gang du'ang mi 'dzin par/ lhag mthong shes rab kyi dbang pos spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bar shes pas gnas lugs skye med kyi ngang du ci gnas su 'jog gang thub byas pas/ 'chi ba chos sku zhes sam gzhi'i dus 'od gsal dang*/ 'chi ba 'od gsal gnyis lam gyi 'od gsal gyis mtshams sbyar bas 'od gsal ma bu mjal ba zhes bya ba yin/ de lta bu'i ngang la ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag pas 'chi ba 'od gsal chos kyi sku 'tshang rgya ba zhes bya ba 'byung ba'i dus so// gal te de dag gi mthar/ 'od gsal spros bral gyi ngang de las langs pa na/ bar do'i 'khrul snang sna tshogs 'char ba byung ba'i tshe sngar nas goms pa'i bskyed rim lha sku sgyu ma lta bu dang*/ rdzogs rim 'od gsal bde ba chen po'i don dran pa tsam gyis zung 'jug tu 'bad rtsol med par nyams su len pa 'byung ba des bar do longs spyod rdzogs sku 'tshang rgya ba'am/ yang na bar do'i 'khrul snang sna tshogs shar bar gyur pa na/ snang ba 'di thams cad bar do'i snang ba yin tshul rgyu mtshan du ma'i sgo nas shes par byas la/ bar do'i snang ba 'di dag ni gang bsgyur bsgyur yin pas bar dor longs sku mngon du byed dgos snyam pa'i ngang nas/

bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor gsal gdab cing*/ khyad par 'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi sogs yul du gang snang thams cad bden 'dzin dang 'jigs skrag mi blta bar/ rang dang snang ba thams cad yi dam gyi lha'i sku/ de'ang snang stong sgyu ma'i snang ba lta bu dang*/ sgra snyan mi snyan grag pa thams cad kyang sngags kyi sgra/ de'ang grag stong gnyis su med pa brag ca lta bu dang*/ sems kyi dran rig 'jigs snang sogs gang shar thams cad/ de'i ngo bo la bltas pas rig tsam rang gi ngo bo la skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i rig stong dbyer med du mnyam par 'jog ci thub byas pas don chen 'grub ste/ der rig pa rang so zin pa skad cig ma gsum gyi yun tsam gnas na'ang don grub ces gsungs so// de lta bu'i snang grag rig gsum lha sngags ye shes gsum du shes pa 'di ni/ da lta'i dus nyid na'ang rnal 'byor bla med kyi nyams len gyi gtso bo nyid du ma brjed pa gal che ste/ gzhan du 'di la goms 'dris med pas mnyam gzhag gi rnal 'byor 'ol tsam res kyang phan 'dogs nus pa 'byung dka' ba tsam du go nas mol ba lags/ mthong chos 'da' ka bar do'i dus// dgos don gdams pa'i zil mngar 'di// zab lam chu gter bsrubs pa'i bcud// bu slob rnam grol gsos su longs// zhes gdams pa bdud rtsi'i zegs ma 'di'ang*/ bu slob dam pa dpal ldan rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ngor/ chos smra ba'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// ka l+yā ṇa bha ban tu/ sarba dza ga tāṃ// ༈ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i mar me'i sreg blugs nyung ngu rab gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /swa sti/ dri bzhon gyis bskyod byi ru'i 'khri shing ni// gzhon nu ltar mdzes rdo rje btsun mo dang*// dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs sen gtsug bkod de// mar me la brten sreg blugs gsal bar 'bri// 'dir gang zhig rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i mar me'i sbyin sreg bya ba'i tshul la gsum las sbyor ba ni/

mdun du stegs ji ltar rigs pa'i steng du mar me'i kong bu yangs pa la ras dmar pos dkris pa'i sdong bu sbom po btsugs nas/ mar dkar gyi khu bas bkang ba bzhag gtor ma yang bsham/ ma 'byor na yid kyis bsams kyang rung*/ bsreg rdzas kyi gtso bo til dang nang mchod rdo rje dril bu sogs kyang bshams/ dngos gzhi ni bdag gi rnal 'byor bzlas pa dang bcas sngon du btang*/ yang na thun mtshams kyi rje btsun mar skad cig gis dran par byas te/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas gtor te/ sum+bha nis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i snod rnams kyi nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi mjug tu dharma ra ṇi rol mo bcas pas byin gyis brlabs/ de nas ngag tu oṃ gsum ma dang oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes pas mar me sbar la/ mar me bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las e yig nyis brtsegs las byung ba'i chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du/ pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bam̐ yig dmar po'i mtha' skor du oṃ sogs nas/ tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo phaiṃ thugs ka'i sogs nas gnyis su med par thim pa'i bar gyis mar me lhar bskyed/ mchod pa rnams/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī re re'i 'gor sbyar ba'i oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ shab+da'i bar rol mo dang bcas pas phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ gsum ma'i rjes su 'bru gsum btags te/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo zhes pas nang mchod 'bul/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs kyis bstod cing*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang nyes pa'i tshogs thams cad sbyong ba'i las mdzad par gyur ces brjod do// de nas til la/

bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes pa'i tshogs thams cad snying ga nas yi ge kaṃ nag po'i rnam pas 'thon/ sna sgor sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur pa til la thim par bsams la/ mtheb srin gyis til nas blangs te/ rje btsun ma'i zhal du phul bar mos la/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba pā pam̐ da ha na swā hā/ zhes bla ma gong ma rnams kyi yi ge phal cher la sngags 'di kho na ltar byung zhing*/ bla ma phyi ma 'ga' zhig ni/ oṃ gsum ma'i rjes su kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba pā paṃ shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes gsungs te gang ltar yang brgya stong la sogs pa ci nus su phul ba'i mthar/ mchod bstod gong ltar byas/ gtor ma yod na byin gyis brlabs pa dang 'bul ba sgrub thabs ltar bya'o// rjes ni thal mo sbyar te bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang nyes pa'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol// zhes 'dod don gsol/ yi ge brgya pa dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang*/ zhes sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pas ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bdag la bsdu/ bdag bskyed rgyas pa dang 'brel na/ rang gi gnas rnams su sogs kyi srung ba rnams byed/ dge ba bsngo zhing 'chi tshe mgon dang sogs kyis smon lam dang bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan te/ mar me mnal ba dang ro ma rnams chu bo'am sa gtsang sar dor/ 'di la 'bad pa byas na sdig pa thams cad 'byong ba dang rje btsun ma'i byin rlabs 'jug pa'i thabs khyad par can du 'gyur bar gsungs so// smras pa/ sa skya'i bla chen las 'ongs gser gyi chos// gong ma'i gsung don tshig gi rgyud mang glur// nye bar blangs pa'i lam nas gsal byas pa// 'di la 'gal dang ma 'brel med par sems// snang byed chung ngu bteg pa'i 'phral de la// stug po'i mun pa'i rang gzugs 'jig pa ltar// tshegs chung thabs kyis dpag yas sdig za bar// bsngags pa'i bden pas 'gro la phan byed shog
